   100→// getSessionLogBySessionID returns all transcripts for a session.
   101→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getSessionLogBySessionID(sessionID string) ([]byte, error) {
   102→	checkpoints, err := s.getCheckpointsForSession(sessionID)
   103→	if err != nil {
   104→		// Fall back to active session shadow branch
   105→		return s.getSessionLogFromShadow(sessionID)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Sort by time (oldest first)
   109→	sort.Slice(checkpoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   110→		return checkpoints[i].CreatedAt.Before(checkpoints[j].CreatedAt)
   111→	})
   112→
   113→	var result []byte
   114→	for i, cp := range checkpoints {
   115→		log, err := s.getCheckpointLog(cp.CheckpointID)
   116→		if err != nil {
   117→			continue
   118→		}
   119→		if i > 0 {
   120→			result = append(result, []byte("\n\n--- Next commit ---\n\n")...)
   121→		}
   122→		result = append(result, log...)
   123→	}
   124→
   125→	if len(result) == 0 {
   126→		return s.getSessionLogFromShadow(sessionID)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	return result, nil
   130→}
   131→
   132→// getSessionLogFromShadow gets transcript from active shadow branch.
   133→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getSessionLogFromShadow(sessionID string) ([]byte, error) {
   134→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   135→	if err != nil {
   136→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   140→	if err != nil || state == nil {
   141→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active session: %s", sessionID)
   142→	}
   143→
   144→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
   145→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   146→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   147→	if err != nil {
   148→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch reference: %w", err)
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   152→	if err != nil {
   153→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   157→	if err != nil {
   158→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   159→	}
   160→
   161→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDir(sessionID)
   162→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   163→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   164→			return []byte(content), nil
   165→		}
   166→	}
   167→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   168→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   169→			return []byte(content), nil
   170→		}
   171→	}
   172→
   173→	return nil, errors.New("no transcript found")
   174→}

   186→// GetSessionInfo returns the current session info.
   187→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetSessionInfo() (*SessionInfo, error) {
   188→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   189→	if err != nil {
   190→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   191→	}
   192→
   193→	// Check if we're on a shadow branch
   194→	head, err := repo.Head()

   196→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   197→	}
   198→
   199→	if head.Name().IsBranch() {
   200→		branchName := head.Name().Short()
   201→		if strings.HasPrefix(branchName, shadowBranchPrefix) {
   202→			return nil, ErrNoSession
   203→		}
   204→	}
   205→
   206→	// Find sessions for current HEAD
   207→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForCommit(head.Hash().String())
   208→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   209→		return nil, ErrNoSession
   210→	}
   211→
   212→	// Return info for most recent session
   213→	state := sessions[0]
   214→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit)
   215→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   216→
   217→	info := &SessionInfo{
   218→		SessionID: state.SessionID,
   219→		Reference: shadowBranchName,
   220→	}
   221→
   222→	if ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true); err == nil {
   223→		info.CommitHash = ref.Hash().String()
   224→	}
   225→
   226→	return info, nil
   227→}

   319→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetAdditionalSessions() ([]*Session, error) {
   320→	activeStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates()

   335→			StartTime:   state.StartedAt,

   483→func (s *AutoCommitStrategy) GetSessionLog(checkpointID string) ([]byte, string, error) {
   484→	// Session logs are on the entire/sessions branch in checkpoint directories
   485→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   486→	if err != nil {
   487→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   488→	}
   489→

   491→	result, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), checkpointID)
   492→	if err != nil {
   493→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   494→	}
   495→	if result == nil {
   496→		// Try legacy format directly if not found in sharded format
   497→		return s.getSessionLogLegacy(checkpointID)
   498→	}
   499→
   500→	return result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil
   501→}

     1→// Package trailers provides parsing and formatting for Entire commit message trailers.
     2→// Trailers are key-value metadata appended to git commit messages following the
     3→// git trailer convention (key: value format after a blank line).
     4→package trailers
     5→
     6→import (
     7→	"fmt"
     8→	"regexp"
     9→	"strings"
    10→
    11→	"entire.io/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/id"
    12→)
    13→
    14→// Trailer key constants used in commit messages.
    15→const (
    16→	// MetadataTrailerKey points to the metadata directory within a commit tree.
    17→	MetadataTrailerKey = "Entire-Metadata"
    18→
    19→	// MetadataTaskTrailerKey points to the task metadata directory for subagent checkpoints.
    20→	MetadataTaskTrailerKey = "Entire-Metadata-Task"
    21→
    22→	// StrategyTrailerKey indicates which strategy created the commit.
    23→	StrategyTrailerKey = "Entire-Strategy"
    24→
    25→	// BaseCommitTrailerKey links shadow commits to their base code commit.
    26→	BaseCommitTrailerKey = "Base-Commit"
    27→
    28→	// SessionTrailerKey identifies which session created a commit.
    29→	SessionTrailerKey = "Entire-Session"
    30→
    31→	// CondensationTrailerKey identifies the condensation ID for a commit (legacy).
    32→	CondensationTrailerKey = "Entire-Condensation"
    33→
    34→	// SourceRefTrailerKey links code commits to their metadata on a shadow/metadata branch.
    35→	// Format: "<branch>@<commit-hash>" e.g. "entire/metadata@abc123def456"
    36→	SourceRefTrailerKey = "Entire-Source-Ref"
    37→
    38→	// CheckpointTrailerKey links commits to their checkpoint metadata on entire/sessions.
    39→	// Format: 12 hex characters e.g. "a3b2c4d5e6f7"
    40→	// This trailer survives git amend and rebase operations.
    41→	CheckpointTrailerKey = "Entire-Checkpoint"
    42→
    43→	// EphemeralBranchTrailerKey identifies the shadow branch that a checkpoint originated from.
    44→	// Used in manual-commit strategy checkpoint commits on entire/sessions branch.
    45→	// Format: full branch name e.g. "entire/2b4c177"
    46→	EphemeralBranchTrailerKey = "Ephemeral-branch"
    47→
    48→	// AgentTrailerKey identifies the agent that created a checkpoint.
    49→	// Format: human-readable agent name e.g. "Claude Code", "Cursor"
    50→	AgentTrailerKey = "Entire-Agent"
    51→)
    52→
    53→// Pre-compiled regexes for trailer parsing.
    54→var (
    55→	// Trailer parsing regexes.
    56→	strategyTrailerRegex     = regexp.MustCompile(StrategyTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    57→	metadataTrailerRegex     = regexp.MustCompile(MetadataTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    58→	taskMetadataTrailerRegex = regexp.MustCompile(MetadataTaskTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    59→	baseCommitTrailerRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(BaseCommitTrailerKey + `:\s*([a-f0-9]{40})`)
    60→	condensationTrailerRegex = regexp.MustCompile(CondensationTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    61→	sessionTrailerRegex      = regexp.MustCompile(SessionTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    62→	checkpointTrailerRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(CheckpointTrailerKey + `:\s*([a-f0-9]+)`)
    63→)
    64→
    65→// ParseStrategy extracts strategy from commit message.
    66→// Returns the strategy name and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    67→func ParseStrategy(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
    68→	matches := strategyTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
    69→	if len(matches) > 1 {
    70→		return NormalizeStrategyName(strings.TrimSpace(matches[1])), true
    71→	}
    72→	return "", false
    73→}
    74→
    75→// ParseMetadata extracts metadata dir from commit message.
    76→// Returns the metadata directory and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    77→func ParseMetadata(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
    78→	matches := metadataTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
    79→	if len(matches) > 1 {
    80→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
    81→	}
    82→	return "", false
    83→}
    84→
    85→// ParseTaskMetadata extracts task metadata dir from commit message.
    86→// Returns the task metadata directory and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    87→func ParseTaskMetadata(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
    88→	matches := taskMetadataTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
    89→	if len(matches) > 1 {
    90→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
    91→	}
    92→	return "", false
    93→}
    94→
    95→// ParseBaseCommit extracts the base commit SHA from a commit message.
    96→// Returns the full SHA and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    97→func ParseBaseCommit(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
    98→	matches := baseCommitTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
    99→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   100→		return matches[1], true
   101→	}
   102→	return "", false
   103→}
   104→
   105→// ParseCondensation extracts the condensation ID from a commit message.
   106→// Returns the condensation ID and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
   107→func ParseCondensation(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
   108→	matches := condensationTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
   109→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   110→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
   111→	}
   112→	return "", false
   113→}
   114→
   115→// ParseSession extracts the session ID from a commit message.
   116→// Returns the session ID and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
   117→// Note: If multiple Entire-Session trailers exist, this returns only the first one.
   118→// Use ParseAllSessions to get all session IDs.
   119→func ParseSession(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
   120→	matches := sessionTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
   121→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   122→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
   123→	}
   124→	return "", false
   125→}
   126→
   127→// ParseCheckpoint extracts the checkpoint ID from a commit message.
   128→// Returns the CheckpointID and true if found, empty ID and false otherwise.
   129→func ParseCheckpoint(commitMessage string) (id.CheckpointID, bool) {
   130→	matches := checkpointTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
   131→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   132→		idStr := strings.TrimSpace(matches[1])
   133→		// Validate it's a proper checkpoint ID
   134→		if cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(idStr); err == nil {
   135→			return cpID, true
   136→		}
   137→	}
   138→	return id.EmptyCheckpointID, false
   139→}
   140→
   141→// ParseAllSessions extracts all session IDs from a commit message.
   142→// Returns a slice of session IDs (may be empty if none found).
   143→// Duplicate session IDs are deduplicated while preserving order.
   144→// This is useful for commits that may have multiple Entire-Session trailers.
   145→func ParseAllSessions(commitMessage string) []string {
   146→	matches := sessionTrailerRegex.FindAllStringSubmatch(commitMessage, -1)
   147→	if len(matches) == 0 {
   148→		return nil
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   152→	sessionIDs := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
   153→	for _, match := range matches {
   154→		if len(match) > 1 {
   155→			sessionID := strings.TrimSpace(match[1])
   156→			if !seen[sessionID] {
   157→				seen[sessionID] = true
   158→				sessionIDs = append(sessionIDs, sessionID)
   159→			}
   160→		}
   161→	}
   162→	return sessionIDs
   163→}
   164→
   165→// NormalizeStrategyName maps legacy strategy names to current names.
   166→// These are the strategy names used during initial development and are kept for backwards
   167→// compatibility.
   168→func NormalizeStrategyName(name string) string {
   169→	switch name {
   170→	case "dual":
   171→		return "auto-commit"
   172→	case "shadow":
   173→		return "manual-commit"
   174→	default:
   175→		return name
   176→	}
   177→}
   178→
   179→// FormatStrategy creates a commit message with just the strategy trailer.
   180→func FormatStrategy(message, strategy string) string {
   181→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   182→}
   183→
   184→// FormatTaskMetadata creates a commit message with task metadata trailer.
   185→func FormatTaskMetadata(message, taskMetadataDir string) string {
   186→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataDir)
   187→}
   188→
   189→// FormatTaskMetadataWithStrategy creates a commit message with task metadata and strategy trailers.
   190→func FormatTaskMetadataWithStrategy(message, taskMetadataDir, strategy string) string {
   191→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataDir, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   192→}
   193→
   194→// FormatSourceRef creates a formatted source ref string for the trailer.
   195→// Format: "<branch>@<commit-hash-prefix>" (hash truncated to 12 chars)
   196→func FormatSourceRef(branch, commitHash string) string {
   197→	shortHash := commitHash
   198→	if len(shortHash) > 12 {
   199→		shortHash = shortHash[:12]
   200→	}
   201→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s@%s", branch, shortHash)
   202→}
   203→
   204→// FormatMetadata creates a commit message with metadata trailer.
   205→func FormatMetadata(message, metadataDir string) string {
   206→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir)
   207→}
   208→
   209→// FormatMetadataWithStrategy creates a commit message with metadata and strategy trailers.
   210→func FormatMetadataWithStrategy(message, metadataDir, strategy string) string {
   211→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   212→}
   213→
   214→// FormatShadowCommit creates a commit message for manual-commit strategy checkpoints.
   215→// Includes Entire-Metadata, Entire-Session, and Entire-Strategy trailers.
   216→func FormatShadowCommit(message, metadataDir, sessionID string) string {
   217→	var sb strings.Builder
   218→	sb.WriteString(message)
   219→	sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   220→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir))
   221→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", SessionTrailerKey, sessionID))
   222→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", StrategyTrailerKey, "manual-commit"))

     1→// Package id provides the CheckpointID type for identifying checkpoints.
     2→// This is a separate package to avoid import cycles between paths, trailers, and checkpoint.
     3→package id
     4→
     5→import (
     6→	"crypto/rand"
     7→	"encoding/hex"
     8→	"fmt"
     9→	"regexp"
    10→)
    11→
    12→// CheckpointID is a 12-character hex identifier for checkpoints.
    13→// It's used to link code commits to metadata on the entire/sessions branch.
    14→type CheckpointID string
    15→
    16→// EmptyCheckpointID represents an unset or invalid checkpoint ID.
    17→const EmptyCheckpointID CheckpointID = ""
    18→
    19→// checkpointIDRegex validates the format: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.
    20→var checkpointIDRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{12}$`)
    21→
    22→// NewCheckpointID creates a CheckpointID from a string, validating its format.
    23→// Returns an error if the string is not a valid 12-character hex ID.
    24→func NewCheckpointID(s string) (CheckpointID, error) {
    25→	if err := Validate(s); err != nil {
    26→		return EmptyCheckpointID, err
    27→	}
    28→	return CheckpointID(s), nil
    29→}
    30→
    31→// MustCheckpointID creates a CheckpointID from a string, panicking if invalid.
    32→// Use only when the ID is known to be valid (e.g., from trusted sources).
    33→func MustCheckpointID(s string) CheckpointID {
    34→	id, err := NewCheckpointID(s)
    35→	if err != nil {
    36→		panic(err)
    37→	}
    38→	return id
    39→}
    40→
    41→// Generate creates a new random 12-character hex checkpoint ID.
    42→func Generate() CheckpointID {
    43→	bytes := make([]byte, 6) // 6 bytes = 12 hex chars
    44→	if _, err := rand.Read(bytes); err != nil {
    45→		panic(fmt.Sprintf("failed to generate random checkpoint ID: %v", err))
    46→	}
    47→	return CheckpointID(hex.EncodeToString(bytes))
    48→}
    49→
    50→// Validate checks if a string is a valid checkpoint ID format.
    51→// Returns an error if invalid, nil if valid.
    52→func Validate(s string) error {
    53→	if !checkpointIDRegex.MatchString(s) {
    54→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint ID %q: must be 12 lowercase hex characters", s)
    55→	}
    56→	return nil
    57→}
    58→
    59→// String returns the checkpoint ID as a string.
    60→func (id CheckpointID) String() string {
    61→	return string(id)
    62→}
    63→
    64→// IsEmpty returns true if the checkpoint ID is empty or unset.
    65→func (id CheckpointID) IsEmpty() bool {
    66→	return id == EmptyCheckpointID
    67→}
    68→
    69→// Path returns the sharded path for this checkpoint ID on entire/sessions.
    70→// Uses first 2 characters as shard (256 buckets), remaining as folder name.
    71→// Example: "a3b2c4d5e6f7" -> "a3/b2c4d5e6f7"
    72→func (id CheckpointID) Path() string {
    73→	if len(id) < 3 {
    74→		return string(id)
    75→	}
    76→	return string(id[:2]) + "/" + string(id[2:])
    77→}
    78→

Now I have a clear picture. Here's the analysis:

## Current Situation

The `GetSessionLog` method is polymorphic - it accepts a string and tries three interpretations:
1. **Checkpoint ID** (12 hex chars) - primary lookup via `entire/sessions` branch
2. **Git commit ref** - resolves to commit, extracts `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer
3. **Session ID** - last resort, searches by session

The interface says `checkpointID string` but the manual-commit implementation names it `commitHash`, and callers pass different things:
- `resume.go:487`, `session.go:342`, `rewind.go:744` → pass checkpoint IDs
- `session.go:71` → passes `commitRef`
- `session.go:102` → passes `sourceCommit`

## Recommendation: Separate Methods + Typed Primary Method

The best approach is to add a typed method while keeping backward compatibility:

```go
// Primary typed method - use when you have a CheckpointID
GetSessionLogByCheckpoint(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error)

// Keep existing for convenience/backward compat, but rename parameter for clarity
GetSessionLog(identifier string) ([]byte, string, error)
```

**Rationale:**
1. **Type safety** - callers with a `CheckpointID` get compile-time checking
2. **Backward compatible** - existing callers continue working
3. **Self-documenting** - separate methods make intent clear
4. **Follows existing pattern** - you already have `GetCheckpointLog(checkpoint Checkpoint)` vs `getCheckpointLog(checkpointID string)`

The implementation would have `GetSessionLog` delegate to `GetSessionLogByCheckpoint` after validation, and handle the commit-ref/session-ID fallback logic.

**Alternative considered:** Accepting only `id.CheckpointID` would be cleaner but forces callers to do their own trailer extraction when they have commit refs, which duplicates logic and makes the API harder to use.

Would you like me to plan this refactor?

2. **Commit ref** → extract `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer → checkpoint ID → lookup

Both paths ultimately resolve to a checkpoint ID. The commit ref path is just convenience for "extract trailer and lookup."

## Updated Recommendation: Typed Only

With session ID removed, I'd recommend just accepting `id.CheckpointID`:

```go
GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error)
```

Callers with commit refs can extract the checkpoint ID themselves:
```go
// Caller has a commit ref
commit, _ := repo.CommitObject(hash)
if cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message); found {
    content, sessionID, err := strat.GetSessionLog(cpID)
}
```

**Why this is better:**
- Single responsibility - method does one thing
- Type-safe at compile time
- No ambiguity about parameter meaning
- Callers are explicit about their intent
- `trailers.ParseCheckpoint` already returns `id.CheckpointID`

The "resolve commit to checkpoint ID" logic is just 3 lines and uses existing `trailers.ParseCheckpoint()`, so it's not worth hiding in the strategy method.

Interesting! They have **separate implementations** with very different complexity:

**AutoCommitStrategy** (simple):
```go
func (s *AutoCommitStrategy) GetSessionLog(checkpointID string) ([]byte, string, error) {
    store, _ := s.getCheckpointStore()
    result, _ := store.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
    return result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil
}
```
- Already expects a checkpoint ID (parameter named correctly)
- Just does direct lookup, no polymorphic logic
- Only fallback is legacy format on `entire/sessions`

**ManualCommitStrategy** (complex):
```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetSessionLog(commitHash string) ([]byte, string, error)
```
- Tries checkpoint ID (12 chars)
- Tries commit ref → extract `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer
- Tries `Entire-Session` trailer
- Tries `Entire-Metadata` trailer (shadow branch)
- Falls back to session ID lookup

## Summary

If you remove session ID logic from manual-commit and also remove the commit-ref convenience, both implementations converge to essentially the same thing: **lookup by checkpoint ID**.

At that point:
1. Change interface to `GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID)`
2. Auto-commit: trivial change (just type the parameter)
3. Manual-commit: significant simplification (remove ~60 lines of fallback logic)

The implementations would still differ in *where* they look (auto-commit uses `checkpoint.GitStore`, manual-commit uses `getCheckpointLog`), but the interface becomes clean and typed.

They're essentially identical:

**Manual-commit `getCheckpointLog`:**
```go
store, _ := s.getCheckpointStore()
result, _ := store.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
return result.Transcript, nil
```

**Auto-commit `GetSessionLog`:**
```go
store, _ := s.getCheckpointStore()
result, _ := store.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
return result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil
```

Same thing! Both use `checkpoint.GitStore.ReadCommitted()`.

## Proposed Refactor

1. **Remove `GetSessionLog` from the `Strategy` interface**

2. **Add a package-level function or method on `checkpoint.GitStore`:**
```go
// In checkpoint package
func (s *GitStore) GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error) {
    result, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, cpID.String())
    if err != nil {
        return nil, "", err
    }
    if result == nil {
        return nil, "", ErrNoMetadata
    }
    return result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil
}
```

3. **For shadow branch lookup (manual-commit only), keep a separate method:**
```go
// Strategy-specific, not on interface
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetSessionLogFromShadow(commitHash plumbing.Hash) ([]byte, string, error)
```

This cleanly separates:
- **Checkpoint lookup** (shared, on GitStore) - the common case
- **Shadow branch lookup** (manual-commit specific) - for uncommitted/active sessions

Callers would use `checkpoint.GitStore` directly for checkpoint lookups, and only use the strategy method when they specifically need shadow branch data.

    26→// WriteCommitted writes a committed checkpoint to the entire/sessions branch.
    27→// Checkpoints are stored at sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    28→//
    29→// For task checkpoints (IsTask=true), additional files are written under tasks/<tool-use-id>/:
    30→//   - For incremental checkpoints: checkpoints/NNN-<tool-use-id>.json
    31→//   - For final checkpoints: checkpoint.json and agent-<agent-id>.jsonl
    32→func (s *GitStore) WriteCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error {
    33→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
    34→
    35→	// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
    36→	if err := id.Validate(opts.CheckpointID); err != nil {
    37→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    38→	}
    39→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    40→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    41→	}
    42→	if err := paths.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
    43→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    44→	}
    45→	if err := paths.ValidateAgentID(opts.AgentID); err != nil {
    46→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	// Ensure sessions branch exists
    50→	if err := s.ensureSessionsBranch(); err != nil {
    51→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to ensure sessions branch: %w", err)
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	// Get current branch tip and flatten tree
    55→	ref, entries, err := s.getSessionsBranchEntries()
    56→	if err != nil {
    57→		return err
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	// Use sharded path: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    61→	basePath := paths.CheckpointPath(opts.CheckpointID) + "/"
    62→
    63→	// Track task metadata path for commit trailer
    64→	var taskMetadataPath string
    65→
    66→	// Handle task checkpoints
    67→	if opts.IsTask && opts.ToolUseID != "" {
    68→		taskMetadataPath, err = s.writeTaskCheckpointEntries(opts, basePath, entries)
    69→		if err != nil {
    70→			return err
    71→		}
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Write standard checkpoint entries (transcript, prompts, context, metadata)
    75→	if err := s.writeStandardCheckpointEntries(opts, basePath, entries); err != nil {
    76→		return err
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	// Build and commit
    80→	newTreeHash, err := BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
    81→	if err != nil {
    82→		return err
    83→	}
    84→
    85→	commitMsg := s.buildCommitMessage(opts, taskMetadataPath)
    86→	newCommitHash, err := s.createCommit(newTreeHash, ref.Hash(), commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
    87→	if err != nil {
    88→		return err
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
    92→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, newCommitHash)
    93→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
    94→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)
    95→	}
    96→
    97→	return nil
    98→}
    99→
   100→// getSessionsBranchEntries returns the sessions branch reference and flattened tree entries.
   101→func (s *GitStore) getSessionsBranchEntries() (*plumbing.Reference, map[string]object.TreeEntry, error) {
   102→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   103→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   104→	if err != nil {
   105→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get sessions branch reference: %w", err)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	parentCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   109→	if err != nil {
   110→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   111→	}
   112→
   113→	baseTree, err := parentCommit.Tree()
   114→	if err != nil {
   115→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   116→	}
   117→
   118→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   119→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   120→		return nil, nil, err
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	return ref, entries, nil
   124→}
   125→
   126→// writeTaskCheckpointEntries writes task-specific checkpoint entries and returns the task metadata path.
   127→func (s *GitStore) writeTaskCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   128→	taskPath := basePath + "tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID + "/"
   129→
   130→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   131→		return s.writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   132→	}
   133→	return s.writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   134→}
   135→
   136→// writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint writes an incremental checkpoint file during task execution.
   137→func (s *GitStore) writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   138→	checkpoint := incrementalCheckpointData{
   139→		Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   140→		ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   141→		Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   142→		Data:      opts.IncrementalData,
   143→	}
   144→	cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   145→	if err != nil {
   146→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   147→	}
   148→	cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   149→	if err != nil {
   150→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   151→	}
   152→
   153→	cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   154→	cpPath := taskPath + "checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   155→	entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   156→		Name: cpPath,
   157→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   158→		Hash: cpBlobHash,
   159→	}
   160→	return cpPath, nil
   161→}
   162→
   163→// writeFinalTaskCheckpoint writes the final checkpoint.json and subagent transcript.
   164→func (s *GitStore) writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   165→	checkpoint := taskCheckpointData{
   166→		SessionID:      opts.SessionID,
   167→		ToolUseID:      opts.ToolUseID,
   168→		CheckpointUUID: opts.CheckpointUUID,
   169→		AgentID:        opts.AgentID,
   170→	}
   171→	checkpointData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   172→	if err != nil {
   173→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal task checkpoint: %w", err)
   174→	}
   175→	blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, checkpointData)
   176→	if err != nil {
   177→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create task checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	checkpointFile := taskPath + "checkpoint.json"
   181→	entries[checkpointFile] = object.TreeEntry{
   182→		Name: checkpointFile,
   183→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   184→		Hash: blobHash,
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// Write subagent transcript if available
   188→	if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   189→		agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath)
   190→		if readErr == nil {
   191→			agentBlobHash, agentBlobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent)
   192→			if agentBlobErr == nil {
   193→				agentPath := taskPath + "agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   194→				entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   195→					Name: agentPath,
   196→					Mode: filemode.Regular,
   197→					Hash: agentBlobHash,
   198→				}
   199→			}
   200→		}
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Return task path without trailing slash
   204→	return taskPath[:len(taskPath)-1], nil
   205→}
   206→
   207→// writeStandardCheckpointEntries writes transcript, prompts, context, metadata.json and any additional files.
   208→// If the checkpoint already exists (from a previous session), archives the existing files to a numbered subfolder.
   209→func (s *GitStore) writeStandardCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   210→	// Check if checkpoint already exists (multi-session support)
   211→	var existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata
   212→	metadataPath := basePath + paths.MetadataFileName
   213→	if entry, exists := entries[metadataPath]; exists {
   214→		// Read existing metadata to get session count
   215→		existing, err := s.readMetadataFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   216→		if err == nil {
   217→			existingMetadata = existing
   218→			// Archive existing session files to numbered subfolder
   219→			s.archiveExistingSession(basePath, existingMetadata, entries)
   220→		}
   221→	}
   222→
   223→	// Write transcript (from in-memory content or file path)
   224→	if err := s.writeTranscript(opts, basePath, entries); err != nil {
   225→		return err
   226→	}
   227→
   228→	// Write prompts
   229→	if len(opts.Prompts) > 0 {
   230→		promptContent := strings.Join(opts.Prompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   231→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(promptContent))
   232→		if err != nil {
   233→			return err
   234→		}
   235→		entries[basePath+paths.PromptFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   236→			Name: basePath + paths.PromptFileName,
   237→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   238→			Hash: blobHash,
   239→		}
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// Write context
   243→	if len(opts.Context) > 0 {
   244→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, opts.Context)
   245→		if err != nil {
   246→			return err
   247→		}
   248→		entries[basePath+paths.ContextFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   249→			Name: basePath + paths.ContextFileName,
   250→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   251→			Hash: blobHash,
   252→		}
   253→	}
   254→
   255→	// Copy additional metadata files from directory if specified
   256→	if opts.MetadataDir != "" {
   257→		if err := s.copyMetadataDir(opts.MetadataDir, basePath, entries); err != nil {
   258→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy metadata directory: %w", err)
   259→		}
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	// Write metadata.json (with merged info if existing metadata present)
   263→	return s.writeMetadataJSON(opts, basePath, entries, existingMetadata)
   264→}
   265→
   266→// writeTranscript writes the transcript file from in-memory content or file path.
   267→func (s *GitStore) writeTranscript(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   268→	transcript := opts.Transcript
   269→	if len(transcript) == 0 && opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   270→		var readErr error
   271→		transcript, readErr = os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath)
   272→		if readErr != nil {
   273→			// Non-fatal: transcript may not exist yet
   274→			transcript = nil
   275→		}
   276→	}
   277→	if len(transcript) == 0 {
   278→		return nil
   279→	}
   280→
   281→	blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, transcript)
   282→	if err != nil {
   283→		return err
   284→	}
   285→	entries[basePath+paths.TranscriptFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   286→		Name: basePath + paths.TranscriptFileName,
   287→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   288→		Hash: blobHash,
   289→	}
   290→
   291→	// Content hash for deduplication
   292→	contentHash := fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256(transcript))
   293→	hashBlob, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(contentHash))
   294→	if err != nil {
   295→		return err
   296→	}
   297→	entries[basePath+paths.ContentHashFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   298→		Name: basePath + paths.ContentHashFileName,
   299→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   300→		Hash: hashBlob,
   301→	}
   302→	return nil
   303→}
   304→
   305→// writeMetadataJSON writes the metadata.json file for the checkpoint.
   306→// If existingMetadata is provided, merges session info from the previous session(s).
   307→func (s *GitStore) writeMetadataJSON(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry, existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata) error {
   308→	metadata := CommittedMetadata{
   309→		CheckpointID:           opts.CheckpointID,
   310→		SessionID:              opts.SessionID,
   311→		Strategy:               opts.Strategy,
   312→		CreatedAt:              time.Now(),
   313→		Branch:                 opts.Branch,
   314→		CheckpointsCount:       opts.CheckpointsCount,
   315→		FilesTouched:           opts.FilesTouched,
   316→		Agent:                  opts.Agent,
   317→		IsTask:                 opts.IsTask,
   318→		ToolUseID:              opts.ToolUseID,
   319→		SessionCount:           1,
   320→		SessionIDs:             []string{opts.SessionID},
   321→		TranscriptUUIDAtStart:  opts.TranscriptUUIDAtStart,
   322→		TranscriptLinesAtStart: opts.TranscriptLinesAtStart,
   323→		TokenUsage:             opts.TokenUsage,
   324→	}
   325→
   326→	// Merge with existing metadata if present (multi-session checkpoint)
   327→	if existingMetadata != nil {
   328→		// Get existing session count (default to 1 for backwards compat)
   329→		existingCount := existingMetadata.SessionCount
   330→		if existingCount == 0 {
   331→			existingCount = 1
   332→		}
   333→		metadata.SessionCount = existingCount + 1
   334→
   335→		// Merge session IDs
   336→		existingIDs := existingMetadata.SessionIDs
   337→		if len(existingIDs) == 0 {
   338→			// Backwards compat: old metadata only had SessionID
   339→			existingIDs = []string{existingMetadata.SessionID}
   340→		}
   341→		metadata.SessionIDs = append(metadata.SessionIDs[:0], existingIDs...)
   342→		metadata.SessionIDs = append(metadata.SessionIDs, opts.SessionID)
   343→
   344→		// Merge files touched (deduplicated)
   345→		metadata.FilesTouched = mergeFilesTouched(existingMetadata.FilesTouched, opts.FilesTouched)
   346→
   347→		// Sum checkpoint counts
   348→		metadata.CheckpointsCount = existingMetadata.CheckpointsCount + opts.CheckpointsCount
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(metadata, "", "  ")
   352→	if err != nil {
   353→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal metadata: %w", err)
   354→	}
   355→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   356→	if err != nil {
   357→		return err
   358→	}
   359→	entries[basePath+paths.MetadataFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   360→		Name: basePath + paths.MetadataFileName,
   361→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   362→		Hash: metadataHash,
   363→	}
   364→	return nil
   365→}
   366→
   367→// mergeFilesTouched combines two file lists, removing duplicates.
   368→func mergeFilesTouched(existing, additional []string) []string {
   369→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   370→	var result []string
   371→
   372→	for _, f := range existing {
   373→		if !seen[f] {
   374→			seen[f] = true
   375→			result = append(result, f)
   376→		}
   377→	}
   378→	for _, f := range additional {
   379→		if !seen[f] {
   380→			seen[f] = true
   381→			result = append(result, f)
   382→		}
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	sort.Strings(result)
   386→	return result
   387→}
   388→
   389→// readMetadataFromBlob reads CommittedMetadata from a blob hash.
   390→func (s *GitStore) readMetadataFromBlob(hash plumbing.Hash) (*CommittedMetadata, error) {
   391→	blob, err := s.repo.BlobObject(hash)
   392→	if err != nil {
   393→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob: %w", err)
   394→	}
   395→
   396→	reader, err := blob.Reader()
   397→	if err != nil {
   398→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob reader: %w", err)
   399→	}
   400→	defer reader.Close()
   401→
   402→	var metadata CommittedMetadata
   403→	if err := json.NewDecoder(reader).Decode(&metadata); err != nil {
   404→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode metadata: %w", err)
   405→	}
   406→
   407→	return &metadata, nil
   408→}
   409→
   410→// archiveExistingSession moves existing session files to a numbered subfolder.
   411→// The subfolder number is based on the current session count (so first archived session goes to "1/").
   412→func (s *GitStore) archiveExistingSession(basePath string, existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) {
   413→	// Determine archive folder number
   414→	sessionCount := existingMetadata.SessionCount
   415→	if sessionCount == 0 {
   416→		sessionCount = 1 // backwards compat
   417→	}
   418→	archivePath := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/", basePath, sessionCount)
   419→
   420→	// Files to archive (standard checkpoint files at basePath, excluding tasks/ subfolder)
   421→	filesToArchive := []string{
   422→		paths.MetadataFileName,
   423→		paths.TranscriptFileName,
   424→		paths.PromptFileName,
   425→		paths.ContextFileName,
   426→		paths.ContentHashFileName,
   427→	}
   428→
   429→	// Move each file to archive folder
   430→	for _, filename := range filesToArchive {
   431→		srcPath := basePath + filename
   432→		if entry, exists := entries[srcPath]; exists {
   433→			// Add to archive location
   434→			dstPath := archivePath + filename
   435→			entries[dstPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   436→				Name: dstPath,
   437→				Mode: entry.Mode,
   438→				Hash: entry.Hash,
   439→			}
   440→			// Remove from original location (will be overwritten by new session)
   441→			delete(entries, srcPath)
   442→		}
   443→	}
   444→}
   445→
   446→// readArchivedSessions reads transcript data from archived session subfolders (1/, 2/, etc.).
   447→// Returns sessions ordered by folder index (oldest first).
   448→func (s *GitStore) readArchivedSessions(checkpointTree *object.Tree, sessionCount int) []ArchivedSession {
   449→	var archived []ArchivedSession
   450→
   451→	// Archived sessions are in numbered folders: 1/, 2/, etc.
   452→	// The most recent session is at the root level (not archived).
   453→	// Session count N means there are N-1 archived sessions.
   454→	for i := 1; i < sessionCount; i++ {
   455→		folderName := strconv.Itoa(i)
   456→
   457→		// Try to get the archived session subtree
   458→		subTree, err := checkpointTree.Tree(folderName)
   459→		if err != nil {
   460→			continue // Folder doesn't exist, skip
   461→		}
   462→
   463→		session := ArchivedSession{
   464→			FolderIndex: i,
   465→		}
   466→
   467→		// Read metadata to get session ID
   468→		if metadataFile, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   469→			if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   470→				var metadata CommittedMetadata
   471→				if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &metadata); jsonErr == nil {
   472→					session.SessionID = metadata.SessionID
   473→				}
   474→			}
   475→		}
   476→
   477→		// Read transcript (try current format first, then legacy)
   478→		if file, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   479→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   480→				session.Transcript = []byte(content)
   481→			}
   482→		} else if file, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   483→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   484→				session.Transcript = []byte(content)
   485→			}
   486→		}
   487→
   488→		// Read prompts
   489→		if file, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   490→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   491→				session.Prompts = content
   492→			}
   493→		}
   494→
   495→		// Only add if we got a transcript
   496→		if len(session.Transcript) > 0 {
   497→			archived = append(archived, session)
   498→		}
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	return archived
   502→}
   503→
   504→// buildCommitMessage constructs the commit message with proper trailers.
   505→// The commit subject is always "Checkpoint: <id>" for consistency.
   506→// If CommitSubject is provided (e.g., for task checkpoints), it's included in the body.
   507→func (s *GitStore) buildCommitMessage(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskMetadataPath string) string {
   508→	var commitMsg strings.Builder
   509→
   510→	// Subject line is always the checkpoint ID for consistent formatting
   511→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoint: %s\n\n", opts.CheckpointID))
   512→
   513→	// Include custom description in body if provided (e.g., task checkpoint details)
   514→	if opts.CommitSubject != "" {
   515→		commitMsg.WriteString(opts.CommitSubject + "\n\n")
   516→	}
   517→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.SessionTrailerKey, opts.SessionID))
   518→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.StrategyTrailerKey, opts.Strategy))
   519→	if opts.Agent != "" {
   520→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.AgentTrailerKey, opts.Agent))
   521→	}
   522→	if opts.EphemeralBranch != "" {
   523→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.EphemeralBranchTrailerKey, opts.EphemeralBranch))
   524→	}
   525→	if taskMetadataPath != "" {
   526→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataPath))
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	return commitMsg.String()
   530→}

   550→// ReadCommitted reads a committed checkpoint by ID from the entire/sessions branch.
   551→// Returns nil, nil if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   552→//
   553→
   554→func (s *GitStore) ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) (*ReadCommittedResult, error) {
   555→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   556→
   557→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   558→	if err != nil {
   559→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // No sessions branch means no checkpoint exists
   560→	}
   561→
   562→	checkpointPath := paths.CheckpointPath(checkpointID)
   563→	checkpointTree, err := tree.Tree(checkpointPath)
   564→	if err != nil {
   565→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Checkpoint directory not found
   566→	}
   567→
   568→	result := &ReadCommittedResult{}
   569→
   570→	// Read metadata.json
   571→	if metadataFile, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   572→		if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   573→			//nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort parsing, defaults are fine
   574→			json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &result.Metadata)
   575→			result.Metadata.Strategy = trailers.NormalizeStrategyName(result.Metadata.Strategy)
   576→		}
   577→	}
   578→
   579→	// Read transcript (try current format first, then legacy)
   580→	if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   581→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   582→			result.Transcript = []byte(content)
   583→		}
   584→	} else if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   585→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   586→			result.Transcript = []byte(content)
   587→		}
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	// Read prompts
   591→	if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   592→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   593→			result.Prompts = content
   594→		}
   595→	}
   596→
   597→	// Read context
   598→	if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.ContextFileName); fileErr == nil {
   599→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   600→			result.Context = content
   601→		}
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Read archived sessions if this is a multi-session checkpoint
   605→	if result.Metadata.SessionCount > 1 {
   606→		result.ArchivedSessions = s.readArchivedSessions(checkpointTree, result.Metadata.SessionCount)
   607→	}
   608→
   609→	return result, nil
   610→}
   611→
   612→// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints from the entire/sessions branch.
   613→// Scans sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/ directories containing metadata.json.
   614→//
   615→
   616→func (s *GitStore) ListCommitted(ctx context.Context) ([]CommittedInfo, error) {
   617→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   618→
   619→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   620→	if err != nil {
   621→		return []CommittedInfo{}, nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions branch means empty list
   622→	}
   623→
   624→	var checkpoints []CommittedInfo
   625→
   626→	// Scan sharded structure: <2-char-prefix>/<remaining-id>/metadata.json
   627→	for _, bucketEntry := range tree.Entries {
   628→		if bucketEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   629→			continue
   630→		}
   631→		// Bucket should be 2 hex chars
   632→		if len(bucketEntry.Name) != 2 {
   633→			continue
   634→		}
   635→
   636→		bucketTree, treeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(bucketEntry.Hash)
   637→		if treeErr != nil {
   638→			continue
   639→		}
   640→
   641→		// Each entry in the bucket is the remaining part of the checkpoint ID
   642→		for _, checkpointEntry := range bucketTree.Entries {
   643→			if checkpointEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   644→				continue
   645→			}
   646→
   647→			checkpointTree, cpTreeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(checkpointEntry.Hash)
   648→			if cpTreeErr != nil {
   649→				continue
   650→			}
   651→
   652→			// Reconstruct checkpoint ID: <bucket><remaining>
   653→			checkpointID := bucketEntry.Name + checkpointEntry.Name
   654→
   655→			info := CommittedInfo{
   656→				CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   657→			}
   658→
   659→			// Get details from metadata file
   660→			if metadataFile, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   661→				if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   662→					var metadata CommittedMetadata
   663→					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &metadata); err == nil {
   664→						info.SessionID = metadata.SessionID
   665→						info.CreatedAt = metadata.CreatedAt
   666→						info.CheckpointsCount = metadata.CheckpointsCount
   667→						info.FilesTouched = metadata.FilesTouched
   668→						info.Agent = metadata.Agent
   669→						info.IsTask = metadata.IsTask
   670→						info.ToolUseID = metadata.ToolUseID
   671→						info.SessionCount = metadata.SessionCount
   672→						info.SessionIDs = metadata.SessionIDs
   673→					}
   674→				}
   675→			}
   676→
   677→			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, info)
   678→		}
   679→	}
   680→
   681→	// Sort by time (most recent first)
   682→	sort.Slice(checkpoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   683→		return checkpoints[i].CreatedAt.After(checkpoints[j].CreatedAt)
   684→	})
   685→
   686→	return checkpoints, nil
   687→}
   688→
   689→// GetTranscript retrieves the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
   690→func (s *GitStore) GetTranscript(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) ([]byte, error) {
   691→	result, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
   692→	if err != nil {
   693→		return nil, err
   694→	}
   695→	if result == nil {
   696→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointID)
   697→	}
   698→	if len(result.Transcript) == 0 {
   699→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   700→	}
   701→	return result.Transcript, nil
   702→}

   704→// ensureSessionsBranch ensures the entire/sessions branch exists.
   705→func (s *GitStore) ensureSessionsBranch() error {
   706→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   707→	_, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   708→	if err == nil {
   709→		return nil // Branch exists
   710→	}
   711→
   712→	// Create orphan branch with empty tree
   713→	emptyTreeHash, err := BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, make(map[string]object.TreeEntry))
   714→	if err != nil {
   715→		return err
   716→	}
   717→
   718→	authorName, authorEmail := getGitAuthorFromRepo(s.repo)
   719→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(emptyTreeHash, plumbing.ZeroHash, "Initialize sessions branch", authorName, authorEmail)
   720→	if err != nil {
   721→		return err
   722→	}
   723→
   724→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   725→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
   726→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)
   727→	}
   728→	return nil
   729→}
   730→
   731→// getSessionsBranchTree returns the tree object for the entire/sessions branch.
   732→func (s *GitStore) getSessionsBranchTree() (*object.Tree, error) {
   733→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   734→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   735→	if err != nil {
   736→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions branch not found: %w", err)
   737→	}
   738→
   739→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   740→	if err != nil {
   741→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   742→	}
   743→
   744→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   745→	if err != nil {
   746→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	return tree, nil
   750→}

   752→// CreateBlobFromContent creates a blob object from in-memory content.
   753→// Exported for use by strategy package (session_test.go)
   754→func CreateBlobFromContent(repo *git.Repository, content []byte) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   755→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   756→	obj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
   757→	obj.SetSize(int64(len(content)))
   758→
   759→	writer, err := obj.Writer()
   760→	if err != nil {
   761→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get object writer: %w", err)
   762→	}
   763→
   764→	_, err = writer.Write(content)
   765→	if err != nil {
   766→		_ = writer.Close()
   767→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content: %w", err)
   768→	}
   769→	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
   770→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to close blob writer: %w", err)
   771→	}
   772→
   773→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   774→	if err != nil {
   775→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob object: %w", err)
   776→	}
   777→	return hash, nil
   778→}
   779→
   780→// copyMetadataDir copies all files from a directory to the checkpoint path.
   781→// Used to include additional metadata files like task checkpoints, subagent transcripts, etc.
   782→func (s *GitStore) copyMetadataDir(metadataDir, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   783→	err := filepath.Walk(metadataDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
   784→		if err != nil {
   785→			return err
   786→		}
   787→		if info.IsDir() {
   788→			return nil
   789→		}
   790→
   791→		// Skip symlinks to prevent reading files outside the metadata directory.
   792→		// A symlink could point to sensitive files (e.g., /etc/passwd) which would
   793→		// then be captured in the checkpoint and stored in git history.
   794→		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   795→			return nil
   796→		}
   797→
   798→		// Get relative path within metadata dir
   799→		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(metadataDir, path)
   800→		if err != nil {
   801→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get relative path for %s: %w", path, err)
   802→		}
   803→
   804→		// Prevent path traversal via symlinks pointing outside the metadata dir
   805→		if strings.HasPrefix(relPath, "..") {
   806→			return fmt.Errorf("path traversal detected: %s", relPath)
   807→		}
   808→
   809→		// Create blob from file
   810→		blobHash, mode, err := createBlobFromFile(s.repo, path)
   811→		if err != nil {
   812→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob for %s: %w", path, err)
   813→		}
   814→
   815→		// Store at checkpoint path
   816→		fullPath := basePath + relPath
   817→		entries[fullPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   818→			Name: fullPath,
   819→			Mode: mode,
   820→			Hash: blobHash,
   821→		}
   822→
   823→		return nil
   824→	})
   825→	if err != nil {
   826→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to walk metadata directory: %w", err)
   827→	}
   828→	return nil
   829→}
   830→
   831→// getGitAuthorFromRepo retrieves the git user.name and user.email from the repository config.
   832→func getGitAuthorFromRepo(repo *git.Repository) (name, email string) {
   833→	// Get repository config (includes local settings)
   834→	cfg, err := repo.Config()
   835→	if err == nil {
   836→		name = cfg.User.Name
   837→		email = cfg.User.Email
   838→	}
   839→
   840→	// Provide sensible defaults if git user is not configured
   841→	if name == "" {
   842→		name = "Unknown"
   843→	}
   844→	if email == "" {
   845→		email = "unknown@local"
   846→	}
   847→
   848→	return name, email
   849→}

     1→// Package checkpoint provides types and interfaces for checkpoint storage.
     2→//
     3→// A Checkpoint captures a point-in-time within a session, containing either
     4→// full state (Temporary) or metadata with a commit reference (Committed).
     5→//
     6→// See docs/architecture/sessions-and-checkpoints.md for the full domain model.
     7→package checkpoint
     8→
     9→import (
    10→	"context"
    11→	"time"
    12→
    13→	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
    14→)
    15→
    16→// Checkpoint represents a save point within a session.
    17→type Checkpoint struct {
    18→	// ID is the unique checkpoint identifier
    19→	ID string
    20→
    21→	// SessionID is the session this checkpoint belongs to
    22→	SessionID string
    23→
    24→	// Timestamp is when this checkpoint was created
    25→	Timestamp time.Time
    26→
    27→	// Type indicates temporary (full state) or committed (metadata only)
    28→	Type Type
    29→
    30→	// Message is a human-readable description of the checkpoint
    31→	Message string
    32→}
    33→
    34→// Type indicates the storage location and lifecycle of a checkpoint.
    35→type Type int
    36→
    37→const (
    38→	// Temporary checkpoints contain full state (code + metadata) and are stored
    39→	// on shadow branches (entire/<commit-hash>). Used for intra-session rewind.
    40→	Temporary Type = iota
    41→
    42→	// Committed checkpoints contain metadata + commit reference and are stored
    43→	// on the entire/sessions branch. They are the permanent record.
    44→	Committed
    45→)
    46→
    47→// Store provides low-level primitives for reading and writing checkpoints.
    48→// This is used by strategies to implement their storage approach.
    49→//
    50→// The interface matches the GitStore implementation signatures directly:
    51→// - WriteTemporary takes WriteTemporaryOptions and returns a result with commit hash and skip status
    52→// - ReadTemporary takes baseCommit (not sessionID) since shadow branches are keyed by commit
    53→// - List methods return implementation-specific info types for richer data
    54→type Store interface {
    55→	// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint (full state) to a shadow branch.
    56→	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    57→	// Returns a result containing the commit hash and whether the checkpoint was skipped.
    58→	// Checkpoints are skipped (deduplicated) when the tree hash matches the previous checkpoint.
    59→	WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error)
    60→
    61→	// ReadTemporary reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
    62→	// baseCommit is the commit hash the session is based on.
    63→	// Returns nil, nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
    64→	ReadTemporary(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string) (*ReadTemporaryResult, error)
    65→
    66→	// ListTemporary lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
    67→	ListTemporary(ctx context.Context) ([]TemporaryInfo, error)
    68→
    69→	// WriteCommitted writes a committed checkpoint to the entire/sessions branch.
    70→	// Checkpoints are stored at sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    71→	WriteCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error
    72→
    73→	// ReadCommitted reads a committed checkpoint by ID.
    74→	// Returns nil, nil if the checkpoint does not exist.
    75→	ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) (*ReadCommittedResult, error)
    76→
    77→	// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints.
    78→	ListCommitted(ctx context.Context) ([]CommittedInfo, error)
    79→}

  "new_string": "// GetTranscript retrieves the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.\nfunc (s *GitStore) GetTranscript(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) ([]byte, error) {\n\tresult, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif result == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"checkpoint not found: %s\", checkpointID)\n\t}\n\tif len(result.Transcript) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"no transcript found for checkpoint: %s\", checkpointID)\n\t}\n\treturn result.Transcript, nil\n}\n\n// GetSessionLog retrieves the session transcript and session ID for a checkpoint.\n// This is the primary method for looking up session logs by checkpoint ID.\n// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.\n// Returns ErrNoTranscript if the checkpoint exists but has no transcript.\nfunc (s *GitStore) GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error) {\n\tresult, err := s.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), cpID.String())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"failed to read checkpoint: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif result == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, \"\", ErrCheckpointNotFound\n\t}\n\tif len(result.Transcript) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, \"\", ErrNoTranscript\n\t}\n\treturn result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil\n}"

   484→	// Session logs are on the entire/sessions branch in checkpoint directories

   486→	if err != nil {

   503→// getSessionLogLegacy reads session logs from legacy format (cond-xxx/full.jsonl).
   504→func (s *AutoCommitStrategy) getSessionLogLegacy(checkpointID string) ([]byte, string, error) {
   505→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   506→	if err != nil {
   507→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   508→	}
   509→	// Get the entire/sessions branch
   510→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   511→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   512→	if err != nil {
   513→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("metadata branch %s not found: %w", paths.MetadataBranchName, err)
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	metadataCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   517→	if err != nil {
   518→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get metadata branch commit: %w", err)
   519→	}
   520→
   521→	tree, err := metadataCommit.Tree()
   522→	if err != nil {
   523→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get metadata tree: %w", err)
   524→	}
   525→
   526→	// Legacy path format
   527→	basePath := checkpointID
   528→
   529→	// Get session ID from metadata.json
   530→	var sessionID string
   531→	metadataPath := basePath + "/metadata.json"
   532→	if metaFile, fileErr := tree.File(metadataPath); fileErr == nil {
   533→		if content, contentErr := metaFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   534→			var metadata map[string]interface{}
   535→			if json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &metadata) == nil {
   536→				if sid, ok := metadata["session_id"].(string); ok {

   540→		}
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Try current format first, then legacy
   544→	transcriptPath := basePath + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName
   545→	file, err := tree.File(transcriptPath)

   100→// getSessionLogBySessionID returns all transcripts for a session.
   101→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) getSessionLogBySessionID(sessionID string) ([]byte, error) {
   102→	checkpoints, err := s.getCheckpointsForSession(sessionID)
   103→	if err != nil {
   104→		// Fall back to active session shadow branch
   105→		return s.getSessionLogFromShadow(sessionID)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	// Sort by time (oldest first)
   109→	sort.Slice(checkpoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   110→		return checkpoints[i].CreatedAt.Before(checkpoints[j].CreatedAt)
   111→	})
   112→
   113→	var result []byte
   114→	for i, cp := range checkpoints {
   115→		log, err := s.getCheckpointLog(cp.CheckpointID)
   116→		if err != nil {
   117→			continue
   118→		}
   119→		if i > 0 {
   120→			result = append(result, []byte("\n\n--- Next commit ---\n\n")...)
   121→		}
   122→		result = append(result, log...)
   123→	}
   124→
   125→	if len(result) == 0 {
   126→		return s.getSessionLogFromShadow(sessionID)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	return result, nil
   130→}

   720→// restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy restores a session transcript using GetSessionLog.
   721→// This is used for strategies that store transcripts in git branches rather than local files.
   722→// Returns the session ID that was actually used (may differ from input if strategy provides one).
   723→func restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(strat strategy.Strategy, checkpointID, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   724→	// Get repo root for agent's session directory lookup
   725→	// Use repo root instead of CWD because Claude stores sessions per-repo,
   726→	// and running from a subdirectory would look up the wrong session directory
   727→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   728→	if err != nil {
   729→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   730→	}
   731→
   732→	// Get agent's session storage directory
   733→	agentSessionDir, err := agent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   734→	if err != nil {
   735→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Ensure session directory exists
   739→	if err := os.MkdirAll(agentSessionDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   740→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   741→	}
   742→
   743→	// Get transcript content from strategy
   744→	content, returnedSessionID, err := strat.GetSessionLog(checkpointID)
   745→	if err != nil {
   746→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	// Use session ID returned from strategy if available (some strategies store it in git)
   750→	// Otherwise fall back to the passed-in sessionID
   751→	if returnedSessionID != "" {
   752→		sessionID = returnedSessionID
   753→	}
   754→
   755→	// Write transcript to agent's session storage
   756→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   757→	sessionFile := filepath.Join(agentSessionDir, agentSessionID+".jsonl")
   758→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   759→	if err := os.WriteFile(sessionFile, content, 0o600); err != nil {
   760→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   761→	}
   762→
   763→	return sessionID, nil
   764→}

   114→// parseSessionTrailers extracts Entire-Session and Entire-Source-Ref from commit message
   115→func parseSessionTrailers(message string) (sessionID, sourceRef string) {
   116→	sessionRe := regexp.MustCompile(trailers.SessionTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
   117→	sourceRe := regexp.MustCompile(trailers.SourceRefTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
   118→
   119→	if matches := sessionRe.FindStringSubmatch(message); len(matches) > 1 {
   120→		sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(matches[1])
   121→	}
   122→	if matches := sourceRe.FindStringSubmatch(message); len(matches) > 1 {
   123→		sourceRef = strings.TrimSpace(matches[1])
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	return sessionID, sourceRef
   127→}

> AGENT

The refactoring is complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary

**1. Added `GetSessionLog` to checkpoint.GitStore** (`checkpoint/committed.go:708`)
- Takes typed `id.CheckpointID` parameter
- Returns `([]byte, string, error)` - transcript, sessionID, error
- Added convenience function `LookupSessionLog(cpID)` that opens repo automatically

**2. Added checkpoint errors** (`checkpoint/checkpoint.go`)
- `ErrCheckpointNotFound` - checkpoint doesn't exist
- `ErrNoTranscript` - checkpoint exists but has no transcript

**3. Removed `GetSessionLog` from Strategy interface** (`strategy/strategy.go`)
- Removed from interface definition

**4. Removed implementations from both strategies**
- `auto_commit.go` - removed `GetSessionLog` and `getSessionLogLegacy`
- `manual_commit_logs.go` - removed `GetSessionLog`, `getSessionLogBySessionID`, and `getSessionLogFromShadow`

**5. Updated callers** to use `checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(cpID)`:
- `resume.go:resumeSingleSession` - validates checkpoint ID then calls checkpoint package
- `session.go:runSessionRaw` - tries checkpoint ID directly, then resolves commit ref
- `session.go:restoreAgentSession` - removed strategy parameter, uses checkpoint directly  
- `rewind.go:restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy` - removed strategy parameter, validates ID first

**Result**: Session log lookup is now type-safe with `id.CheckpointID`, centralized in the checkpoint package, and the Strategy interface is simpler. The shadow branch lookup for uncommitted sessions was removed since callers fallback to local files when checkpoint lookup fails.

You're right to ask. I think I may have broken shadow branch log retrieval. Let me trace through what we lost:

**Before refactor**, `getSessionLogFromShadow` did:
1. Load session state by session ID
2. Get shadow branch name from base commit
3. Read transcript from the shadow branch commit tree at `metadataDir/full.jsonl`

**Now**, for shadow branch checkpoints:
1. `CheckpointID` is empty (shadow branch points don't have one)
2. Falls back to `selectedPoint.ID` (40-char commit hash) 
3. `restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy` fails with "invalid checkpoint ID"
4. Falls back to `restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, ...)` - reads from **local filesystem**

**The problem**: For shadow branch checkpoints, `MetadataDir` is a path within the git tree (`.entire/metadata/<session-id>/`). During an active session, this path exists locally. But if reading from git tree is needed (for historical checkpoints), we've lost that ability.

Let me add a method to read transcripts from shadow branch trees.

   371→// ListTemporaryCheckpoints lists all checkpoint commits on a shadow branch.
   372→// This returns individual commits (rewind points), not just branch info.
   373→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   374→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporaryCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   375→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   376→
   377→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit)
   378→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   379→
   380→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   381→	if err != nil {
   382→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // No shadow branch is expected case
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	iter, err := s.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: ref.Hash()})
   386→	if err != nil {
   387→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   388→	}
   389→
   390→	var results []TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   391→	count := 0
   392→
   393→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   394→		if count >= limit*5 { // Scan more to allow for session filtering
   395→			return errStop
   396→		}
   397→		count++
   398→
   399→		// Verify commit belongs to target session via Entire-Session trailer
   400→		commitSessionID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(c.Message)
   401→		if !hasTrailer {
   402→			return nil // Skip commits without session trailer
   403→		}
   404→		if sessionID != "" && commitSessionID != sessionID {
   405→			return nil // Skip commits from other sessions
   406→		}
   407→
   408→		// Get first line of message
   409→		message := c.Message
   410→		if idx := strings.Index(message, "\n"); idx > 0 {
   411→			message = message[:idx]
   412→		}
   413→
   414→		info := TemporaryCheckpointInfo{
   415→			CommitHash: c.Hash,
   416→			Message:    message,
   417→			SessionID:  commitSessionID,
   418→			Timestamp:  c.Author.When,
   419→		}
   420→
   421→		// Check for task checkpoint first
   422→		taskMetadataDir, foundTask := trailers.ParseTaskMetadata(c.Message)
   423→		if foundTask {
   424→			info.IsTaskCheckpoint = true
   425→			info.MetadataDir = taskMetadataDir
   426→			info.ToolUseID = extractToolUseIDFromPath(taskMetadataDir)
   427→		} else {
   428→			metadataDir, found := trailers.ParseMetadata(c.Message)
   429→			if found {
   430→				info.MetadataDir = metadataDir
   431→			}
   432→		}
   433→
   434→		results = append(results, info)
   435→
   436→		if len(results) >= limit {
   437→			return errStop
   438→		}
   439→		return nil
   440→	})
   441→
   442→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   443→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	return results, nil
   447→}
   448→
   449→// extractToolUseIDFromPath extracts the ToolUseID from a task metadata directory path.
   450→// Task metadata dirs have format: .entire/metadata/<session>/tasks/<toolUseID>
   451→func extractToolUseIDFromPath(metadataDir string) string {
   452→	parts := strings.Split(metadataDir, "/")
   453→	if len(parts) >= 2 && parts[len(parts)-2] == "tasks" {
   454→		return parts[len(parts)-1]
   455→	}
   456→	return ""
   457→}

  "new_string": "// errStop is a sentinel error used to break out of git log iteration.\nvar errStop = errors.New(\"stop iteration\")\n\n// GetTranscriptFromCommit retrieves the transcript from a specific commit's tree.\n// This is used for shadow branch checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the commit tree\n// rather than on the entire/sessions branch.\n// commitHash is the commit to read from, metadataDir is the path within the tree.\nfunc (s *GitStore) GetTranscriptFromCommit(commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) ([]byte, error) {\n\tcommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(commitHash)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get commit: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\ttree, err := commit.Tree()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get commit tree: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Try current format first, then legacy\n\ttranscriptPath := metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileName\n\tif file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {\n\t\tcontent, contentErr := file.Contents()\n\t\tif contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\treturn []byte(content), nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\ttranscriptPath = metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy\n\tif file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {\n\t\tcontent, contentErr := file.Contents()\n\t\tif contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\treturn []byte(content), nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil, ErrNoTranscript\n}"
}

   267→	// Confirm rewind
   268→	var confirm bool
   269→	description := fmt.Sprintf("This will reset to: %s\nChanges after this point may be lost!", selectedPoint.Message)
   270→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
   271→		huh.NewGroup(
   272→			huh.NewConfirm().
   273→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Reset to %s?", shortID)).
   274→				Description(description).
   275→				Value(&confirm),
   276→		),
   277→	)
   278→
   279→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
   280→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
   281→	}
   282→
   283→	if !confirm {
   284→		fmt.Println("Rewind cancelled.")
   285→		return nil
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   289→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(selectedPoint.Agent)
   290→	if err != nil {
   291→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   292→	}
   293→
   294→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   295→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   296→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   297→
   298→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind started",
   299→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   300→		slog.String("session_id", selectedPoint.SessionID),
   301→		slog.Bool("is_task_checkpoint", selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint),
   302→	)
   303→
   304→	// Perform the rewind using strategy
   305→	if err := start.Rewind(*selectedPoint); err != nil {
   306→		logging.Error(ctx, "rewind failed",
   307→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   308→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   309→		)
   310→		return err
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind completed",
   314→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   315→	)
   316→
   317→	// Handle transcript restoration differently for task checkpoints
   318→	var sessionID string
   319→	var transcriptFile string
   320→
   321→	if selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   322→		// For task checkpoint: read checkpoint.json to get UUID and truncate transcript
   323→		checkpoint, err := start.GetTaskCheckpoint(*selectedPoint)
   324→		if err != nil {
   325→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to read task checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   326→			return nil
   327→		}
   328→
   329→		sessionID = checkpoint.SessionID
   330→
   331→		if checkpoint.CheckpointUUID != "" {
   332→			// Truncate transcript at checkpoint UUID
   333→			if err := restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(start, *selectedPoint, sessionID, checkpoint.CheckpointUUID, agent); err != nil {
   334→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore truncated session transcript: %v\n", err)
   335→			} else {
   336→				fmt.Printf("Rewound to task checkpoint. %s\n", formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   337→			}
   338→			return nil
   339→		}
   340→	} else {
   341→		// For session checkpoint: restore full transcript
   342→		sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(selectedPoint.MetadataDir)
   343→		transcriptFile = filepath.Join(selectedPoint.MetadataDir, paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy)
   344→	}
   345→
   346→	// Try to restore using checkpoint storage first (for strategies that store transcripts in git)
   347→	// Use checkpoint ID if available
   348→	lookupID := selectedPoint.CheckpointID
   349→	if lookupID == "" {
   350→		lookupID = selectedPoint.ID
   351→	}
   352→	if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(lookupID, sessionID, agent); err != nil {
   353→		// Fall back to local file
   354→		if err := restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, sessionID, agent); err != nil {
   355→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore session transcript: %v\n", err)
   356→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Source: %s\n", transcriptFile)
   357→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session ID: %s\n", sessionID)
   358→		}
   359→	} else {
   360→		// Use session ID returned from checkpoint (may differ from what we extracted from metadata path)
   361→		sessionID = returnedSessionID
   362→	}
   363→
   364→	fmt.Printf("Rewound to %s. %s\n", shortID, formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   365→	return nil
   366→}
