   368→func runRewindList() error {
   369→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   370→	if skip, _ := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   371→		// Return empty list for programmatic consumers
   372→		fmt.Println("[]")
   373→		return nil
   374→	}
   375→
   376→	start := GetStrategy()
   377→
   378→	points, err := start.GetRewindPoints(20)
   379→	if err != nil {
   380→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find rewind points: %w", err)
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Output as JSON for programmatic use
   384→	type jsonPoint struct {
   385→		ID               string `json:"id"`
   386→		Message          string `json:"message"`
   387→		MetadataDir      string `json:"metadata_dir"`
   388→		Date             string `json:"date"`
   389→		IsTaskCheckpoint bool   `json:"is_task_checkpoint"`
   390→		ToolUseID        string `json:"tool_use_id,omitempty"`
   391→		IsLogsOnly       bool   `json:"is_logs_only"`
   392→		CondensationID   string `json:"condensation_id,omitempty"`
   393→		SessionID        string `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
   394→		SessionPrompt    string `json:"session_prompt,omitempty"`
   395→	}
   396→
   397→	output := make([]jsonPoint, len(points))
   398→	for i, p := range points {
   399→		output[i] = jsonPoint{
   400→			ID:               p.ID,
   401→			Message:          p.Message,
   402→			MetadataDir:      p.MetadataDir,
   403→			Date:             p.Date.Format(time.RFC3339),
   404→			IsTaskCheckpoint: p.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   405→			ToolUseID:        p.ToolUseID,
   406→			IsLogsOnly:       p.IsLogsOnly,
   407→			CondensationID:   p.CheckpointID,
   408→			SessionID:        p.SessionID,
   409→			SessionPrompt:    p.SessionPrompt,
   410→		}
   411→	}
   412→
   413→	// Print as JSON
   414→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(output, "", "  ")
   415→	if err != nil {
   416→		return err
   417→	}
   418→	fmt.Println(string(data))
   419→	return nil
   420→}

   422→func runRewindToWithOptions(commitID string, logsOnly bool, reset bool) error {
   423→	return runRewindToInternal(commitID, logsOnly, reset)
   424→}
   425→
   426→func runRewindToInternal(commitID string, logsOnly bool, reset bool) error {
   427→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   428→	if skip, _ := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   429→		return errors.New("entire tracking is disabled on the default branch for this strategy - create a feature branch to use rewind")
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	start := GetStrategy()
   433→
   434→	// Check for uncommitted changes (skip for reset which handles this itself)
   435→	if !reset {
   436→		canRewind, changeMsg, err := start.CanRewind()
   437→		if err != nil {
   438→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check for uncommitted changes: %w", err)
   439→		}
   440→		if !canRewind {
   441→			return fmt.Errorf("%s", changeMsg)
   442→		}
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// Get rewind points
   446→	points, err := start.GetRewindPoints(20)
   447→	if err != nil {
   448→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find rewind points: %w", err)
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Find the matching point (support both full and short commit IDs)
   452→	var selectedPoint *strategy.RewindPoint
   453→	for _, p := range points {
   454→		if p.ID == commitID || (len(commitID) >= 7 && len(p.ID) >= 7 && strings.HasPrefix(p.ID, commitID)) {
   455→			pointCopy := p
   456→			selectedPoint = &pointCopy
   457→			break
   458→		}
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	if selectedPoint == nil {
   462→		return fmt.Errorf("rewind point not found: %s", commitID)
   463→	}
   464→
   465→	// Handle reset mode (for logs-only points)
   466→	if reset {
   467→		return handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive(start, *selectedPoint)
   468→	}
   469→
   470→	// Handle logs-only restoration:
   471→	// 1. For logs-only points, always use logs-only restoration
   472→	// 2. If --logs-only flag is set, use logs-only restoration even for checkpoint points
   473→	if selectedPoint.IsLogsOnly || logsOnly {
   474→		return handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive(start, *selectedPoint)
   475→	}
   476→
   477→	// Preview rewind to show warnings about files that will be deleted
   478→	preview, previewErr := start.PreviewRewind(*selectedPoint)
   479→	if previewErr == nil && preview != nil && len(preview.FilesToDelete) > 0 {
   480→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nWarning: The following untracked files will be DELETED:\n")
   481→		for _, f := range preview.FilesToDelete {
   482→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", f)
   483→		}
   484→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\n")
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   488→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(selectedPoint.Agent)
   489→	if err != nil {
   490→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   491→	}
   492→
   493→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   494→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   495→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   496→
   497→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind started",
   498→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   499→		slog.String("session_id", selectedPoint.SessionID),
   500→		slog.Bool("is_task_checkpoint", selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint),
   501→	)
   502→
   503→	// Perform the rewind
   504→	if err := start.Rewind(*selectedPoint); err != nil {
   505→		logging.Error(ctx, "rewind failed",
   506→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   507→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   508→		)
   509→		return err
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind completed",
   513→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   514→	)
   515→
   516→	// Handle transcript restoration
   517→	var sessionID string
   518→	var transcriptFile string
   519→
   520→	if selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   521→		checkpoint, err := start.GetTaskCheckpoint(*selectedPoint)
   522→		if err != nil {
   523→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to read task checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   524→			return nil
   525→		}
   526→
   527→		sessionID = checkpoint.SessionID
   528→
   529→		if checkpoint.CheckpointUUID != "" {
   530→			// Use strategy-based transcript restoration for task checkpoints
   531→			if err := restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(start, *selectedPoint, sessionID, checkpoint.CheckpointUUID, agent); err != nil {
   532→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore truncated session transcript: %v\n", err)
   533→			} else {
   534→				fmt.Printf("Rewound to task checkpoint. %s\n", formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   535→			}
   536→			return nil
   537→		}
   538→	} else {
   539→		sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(selectedPoint.MetadataDir)
   540→		transcriptFile = filepath.Join(selectedPoint.MetadataDir, paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy)
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Try to restore using checkpoint storage first (for strategies that store transcripts in git)
   544→	// Use checkpoint ID if available
   545→	lookupID := selectedPoint.CheckpointID
   546→	if lookupID == "" {
   547→		lookupID = selectedPoint.ID
   548→	}
   549→	if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(lookupID, sessionID, agent); err != nil {
   550→		// Fall back to local file
   551→		if err := restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, sessionID, agent); err != nil {
   552→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore session transcript: %v\n", err)
   553→		}
   554→	} else {
   555→		// Use session ID returned from checkpoint (may differ from what we extracted from metadata path)
   556→		sessionID = returnedSessionID
   557→	}
   558→
   559→	fmt.Printf("Rewound to %s. %s\n", selectedPoint.ID[:7], formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   560→	return nil
   561→}
   562→
   563→// handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive handles logs-only rewind in non-interactive mode.
   564→// Defaults to restoring logs only (no checkout) for safety.
   565→func handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) error {
   566→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   567→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(point.Agent)
   568→	if err != nil {
   569→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   570→	}
   571→
   572→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   573→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   574→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   575→
   576→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only rewind started",
   577→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   578→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   579→	)
   580→
   581→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   582→	if !ok {
   583→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   584→	}
   585→
   586→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   587→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only rewind failed",
   588→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   589→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   590→		)
   591→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   592→	}
   593→
   594→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only rewind completed",
   595→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   596→	)
   597→
   598→	// Show resume commands for all sessions
   599→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   600→
   601→	fmt.Println("Note: Working directory unchanged. Use interactive mode for full checkout.")
   602→	return nil
   603→}
   604→
   605→// handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive handles reset in non-interactive mode.
   606→// This performs a git reset --hard to the target commit.
   607→func handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) error {
   608→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   609→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(point.Agent)
   610→	if err != nil {
   611→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   612→	}
   613→
   614→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   615→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   616→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   617→
   618→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset started",
   619→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   620→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   621→	)
   622→
   623→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   624→	if !ok {
   625→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   626→	}
   627→
   628→	// Get current HEAD before reset (for recovery message)
   629→	currentHead, headErr := getCurrentHeadHash()
   630→	if headErr != nil {
   631→		currentHead = ""
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	// Restore logs first
   635→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   636→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during log restoration",
   637→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   638→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   639→		)
   640→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   641→	}
   642→
   643→	// Perform git reset --hard
   644→	if err := performGitResetHard(point.ID); err != nil {
   645→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during git reset",
   646→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   647→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   648→		)
   649→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reset branch: %w", err)
   650→	}
   651→
   652→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset completed",
   653→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   654→	)
   655→
   656→	shortID := point.ID
   657→	if len(shortID) > 7 {
   658→		shortID = shortID[:7]
   659→	}
   660→
   661→	fmt.Printf("Reset branch to %s.\n", shortID)
   662→
   663→	// Show resume commands for all sessions
   664→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   665→
   666→	// Show recovery instructions
   667→	if currentHead != "" && currentHead != point.ID {
   668→		currentShort := currentHead
   669→		if len(currentShort) > 7 {
   670→			currentShort = currentShort[:7]
   671→		}
   672→		fmt.Printf("\nTo undo this reset: git reset --hard %s\n", currentShort)
   673→	}
   674→
   675→	return nil
   676→}
   677→
   678→func extractSessionIDFromMetadata(metadataDir string) string {
   679→	// Metadata dir format varies by strategy:
   680→	// - manual-commit/commit: .entire/metadata/2025-01-25-<session-id>
   681→	// - auto-commit: ab/cdef1234.../2025-11-28-<session-id>
   682→	base := filepath.Base(metadataDir)
   683→	// Try to extract UUID from the end (format: YYYY-MM-DD-uuid)
   684→	parts := strings.SplitN(base, "-", 4)
   685→	if len(parts) >= 4 {
   686→		return parts[3]
   687→	}
   688→	return base
   689→}
   690→
   691→func restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) error {
   692→	// Get repo root for agent's session directory lookup
   693→	// Use repo root instead of CWD because Claude stores sessions per-repo,
   694→	// and running from a subdirectory would look up the wrong session directory
   695→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   696→	if err != nil {
   697→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   698→	}
   699→
   700→	// Get agent's session storage directory
   701→	sessionDir, err := agent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   702→	if err != nil {
   703→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   704→	}
   705→
   706→	// Ensure session directory exists
   707→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   708→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   709→	}
   710→
   711→	// Extract agent's session ID format from Entire session ID
   712→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   713→	sessionFile := filepath.Join(sessionDir, agentSessionID+".jsonl")
   714→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copying transcript:\n  From: %s\n  To: %s\n", transcriptFile, sessionFile)
   715→	if err := copyFile(transcriptFile, sessionFile); err != nil {
   716→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   717→	}
   718→
   719→	return nil
   720→}
   721→
   722→// restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy restores a session transcript from checkpoint storage.
   723→// This is used for strategies that store transcripts in git branches rather than local files.
   724→// Returns the session ID that was actually used (may differ from input if checkpoint provides one).
   725→func restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(checkpointID, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   726→	// Validate checkpoint ID
   727→	cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(checkpointID)
   728→	if err != nil {
   729→		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   730→	}
   731→
   732→	// Get transcript content from checkpoint storage
   733→	content, returnedSessionID, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(cpID)
   734→	if err != nil {
   735→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Use session ID returned from checkpoint if available
   739→	// Otherwise fall back to the passed-in sessionID
   740→	if returnedSessionID != "" {
   741→		sessionID = returnedSessionID
   742→	}
   743→
   744→	return writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content, sessionID, agent)
   745→}
   746→
   747→// restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow restores a session transcript from a shadow branch commit.
   748→// This is used for uncommitted checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the shadow branch tree.
   749→func restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow(commitHash, metadataDir, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   750→	// Open repository
   751→	repo, err := git.PlainOpenWithOptions(".", &git.PlainOpenOptions{DetectDotGit: true})
   752→	if err != nil {
   753→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   754→	}
   755→
   756→	// Parse commit hash
   757→	hash := plumbing.NewHash(commitHash)
   758→	if hash.IsZero() {
   759→		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid commit hash: %s", commitHash)
   760→	}
   761→
   762→	// Get transcript from shadow branch commit tree
   763→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   764→	content, err := store.GetTranscriptFromCommit(hash, metadataDir)
   765→	if err != nil {
   766→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get transcript from shadow branch: %w", err)
   767→	}
   768→
   769→	return writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content, sessionID, agent)
   770→}
   771→
   772→// writeTranscriptToAgentSession writes transcript content to the agent's session storage.
   773→func writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content []byte, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   774→	// Get repo root for agent's session directory lookup
   775→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   776→	if err != nil {
   777→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   778→	}
   779→
   780→	// Get agent's session storage directory
   781→	agentSessionDir, err := agent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	// Ensure session directory exists
   787→	if err := os.MkdirAll(agentSessionDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   788→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   789→	}
   790→
   791→	// Write transcript to agent's session storage
   792→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   793→	sessionFile := filepath.Join(agentSessionDir, agentSessionID+".jsonl")
   794→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   795→	if err := os.WriteFile(sessionFile, content, 0o600); err != nil {
   796→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   797→	}
   798→
   799→	return sessionID, nil
   800→}
   801→
   802→// restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript restores a truncated transcript for a task checkpoint.
   803→// Uses GetTaskCheckpointTranscript to fetch the transcript from the strategy.
   804→func restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(strat strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, sessionID, checkpointUUID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) error {
   805→	// Get transcript content from strategy
   806→	content, err := strat.GetTaskCheckpointTranscript(point)
   807→	if err != nil {
   808→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get task checkpoint transcript: %w", err)
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	// Parse the transcript
   812→	transcript, err := parseTranscriptFromBytes(content)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	// Truncate at checkpoint UUID
   818→	truncated := TruncateTranscriptAtUUID(transcript, checkpointUUID)
   819→
   820→	// Get repo root for agent's session directory lookup
   821→	// Use repo root instead of CWD because Claude stores sessions per-repo,
   822→	// and running from a subdirectory would look up the wrong session directory
   823→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   824→	if err != nil {
   825→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   826→	}
   827→
   828→	// Get agent's session storage directory
   829→	agentSessionDir, err := agent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   830→	if err != nil {
   831→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   832→	}
   833→
   834→	// Ensure session directory exists
   835→	if err := os.MkdirAll(agentSessionDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   836→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   837→	}
   838→
   839→	// Write truncated transcript to agent's session storage
   840→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   841→	sessionFile := filepath.Join(agentSessionDir, agentSessionID+".jsonl")
   842→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing truncated transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   843→
   844→	if err := writeTranscript(sessionFile, truncated); err != nil {
   845→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write truncated transcript: %w", err)
   846→	}
   847→
   848→	return nil
   849→}
   850→
   851→// createContextFileMinimal creates a context file without staged files info
   852→// (since the strategy will handle staging)
   853→func createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile string, transcript []transcriptLine) error {
   854→	prompt, _ := os.ReadFile(promptFile)   //nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort loading of optional context files
   855→	summary, _ := os.ReadFile(summaryFile) //nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort loading of optional context files
   856→	keyActions := extractKeyActions(transcript, 10)
   857→
   858→	var content strings.Builder
   859→	content.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   860→	content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Session ID:** %s\n\n", sessionID))
   861→	content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Commit Message:** %s\n\n", commitMessage))
   862→	content.WriteString("## Prompt\n\n")
   863→	content.Write(prompt)
   864→	content.WriteString("\n\n## Summary\n\n")
   865→	content.Write(summary)
   866→	content.WriteString("\n\n## Key Actions\n\n")
   867→	for _, action := range keyActions {
   868→		content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("- %s\n", action))
   869→	}
   870→
   871→	if err := os.WriteFile(contextFile, []byte(content.String()), 0o600); err != nil {
   872→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write context file: %w", err)
   873→	}
   874→	return nil
   875→}

   877→// handleLogsOnlyRewindInteractive handles rewind for logs-only points with a sub-choice menu.
   878→func handleLogsOnlyRewindInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
   879→	var action string
   880→
   881→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   882→		huh.NewGroup(
   883→			huh.NewSelect[string]().
   884→				Title("Logs-only point: "+shortID).
   885→				Description("This commit has session logs but no checkpoint state. Choose an action:").
   886→				Options(
   887→					huh.NewOption("Restore logs only (keep current files)", "logs"),
   888→					huh.NewOption("Checkout commit (detached HEAD, for viewing)", "checkout"),
   889→					huh.NewOption("Reset branch to this commit (destructive!)", "reset"),
   890→					huh.NewOption("Cancel", "cancel"),
   891→				).
   892→				Value(&action),
   893→		),
   894→	)
   895→
   896→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   897→		return fmt.Errorf("action selection cancelled: %w", err)
   898→	}
   899→
   900→	switch action {
   901→	case "logs":
   902→		return handleLogsOnlyRestore(start, point)
   903→	case "checkout":
   904→		return handleLogsOnlyCheckout(start, point, shortID)
   905→	case "reset":
   906→		return handleLogsOnlyReset(start, point, shortID)
   907→	case "cancel":
   908→		fmt.Println("Rewind cancelled.")
   909→		return nil
   910→	}
   911→
   912→	return nil
   913→}

   915→// handleLogsOnlyRestore restores only the session logs without changing files.
   916→func handleLogsOnlyRestore(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) error {
   917→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   918→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(point.Agent)
   919→	if err != nil {
   920→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   921→	}
   922→
   923→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   924→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   925→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   926→
   927→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only restore started",
   928→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   929→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   930→	)
   931→
   932→	// Check if strategy supports logs-only restoration
   933→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   934→	if !ok {
   935→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   936→	}
   937→
   938→	// Restore logs
   939→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   940→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only restore failed",
   941→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   942→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   943→		)
   944→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   945→	}
   946→
   947→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only restore completed",
   948→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   949→	)
   950→
   951→	// Show resume commands for all sessions
   952→	fmt.Println("Restored session logs.")
   953→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   954→	return nil
   955→}

   957→// handleLogsOnlyCheckout restores logs and checks out the commit (detached HEAD).
   958→func handleLogsOnlyCheckout(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
   959→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   960→	agent, err := getAgentWithFallback(point.Agent)
   961→	if err != nil {
   962→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   963→	}
   964→
   965→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   966→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   967→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   968→
   969→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only checkout started",
   970→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   971→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   972→	)
   973→
   974→	// First, restore the logs
   975→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   976→	if !ok {
   977→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   981→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only checkout failed during log restoration",
   982→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   983→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   984→		)
   985→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   986→	}
   987→
   988→	// Show warning about detached HEAD
   989→	var confirm bool
   990→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
   991→		huh.NewGroup(
   992→			huh.NewConfirm().
   993→				Title("Create detached HEAD?").
   994→				Description("This will checkout the commit directly. You'll be in 'detached HEAD' state.\nAny uncommitted changes will be lost!").
   995→				Value(&confirm),
   996→		),
   997→	)
   998→
   999→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
  1000→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
  1001→	}
  1002→
  1003→	if !confirm {
  1004→		fmt.Println("Checkout cancelled. Session logs were still restored.")
  1005→		printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1006→		return nil
  1007→	}
  1008→
  1009→	// Perform git checkout
  1010→	if err := CheckoutBranch(point.ID); err != nil {
  1011→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only checkout failed during git checkout",
  1012→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1013→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1014→		)
  1015→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to checkout commit: %w", err)
  1016→	}
  1017→
  1018→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only checkout completed",
  1019→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1020→	)
  1021→
  1022→	fmt.Printf("Checked out %s (detached HEAD).\n", shortID)
  1023→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1024→	return nil
  1025→}

  1027→// handleLogsOnlyReset restores logs and resets the branch to the commit (destructive).
  1028→func handleLogsOnlyReset(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
  1029→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
  1030→	agent, agentErr := getAgentWithFallback(point.Agent)
  1031→	if agentErr != nil {
  1032→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", agentErr)
  1033→	}
  1034→
  1035→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
  1036→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
  1037→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
  1038→
  1039→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset (interactive) started",
  1040→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1041→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
  1042→	)
  1043→
  1044→	// First, restore the logs
  1045→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
  1046→	if !ok {
  1047→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
  1048→	}
  1049→
  1050→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
  1051→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during log restoration",
  1052→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1053→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1054→		)
  1055→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
  1056→	}
  1057→
  1058→	// Get current HEAD before reset (for recovery message)
  1059→	currentHead, err := getCurrentHeadHash()
  1060→	if err != nil {
  1061→		// Non-fatal - just won't show recovery message
  1062→		currentHead = ""
  1063→	}
  1064→
  1065→	// Get detailed uncommitted changes warning from strategy
  1066→	var uncommittedWarning string
  1067→	if _, warn, err := start.CanRewind(); err == nil {
  1068→		uncommittedWarning = warn
  1069→	}
  1070→
  1071→	// Check for safety issues
  1072→	warnings, err := checkResetSafety(point.ID, uncommittedWarning)
  1073→	if err != nil {
  1074→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check reset safety: %w", err)
  1075→	}
  1076→
  1077→	// Build confirmation message based on warnings
  1078→	var confirmTitle, confirmDesc string
  1079→	if len(warnings) > 0 {
  1080→		confirmTitle = "⚠️  Reset branch with warnings?"
  1081→		confirmDesc = "WARNING - the following issues were detected:\n" +
  1082→			strings.Join(warnings, "\n") +
  1083→			"\n\nThis will move your branch to " + shortID + " and DISCARD commits after it!"
  1084→	} else {
  1085→		confirmTitle = "Reset branch to " + shortID + "?"
  1086→		confirmDesc = "This will move your branch pointer to this commit.\nCommits after this point will be orphaned (but recoverable via reflog)."
  1087→	}
  1088→
  1089→	var confirm bool
  1090→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
  1091→		huh.NewGroup(
  1092→			huh.NewConfirm().
  1093→				Title(confirmTitle).
  1094→				Description(confirmDesc).
  1095→				Value(&confirm),
  1096→		),
  1097→	)
  1098→
  1099→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
  1100→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
  1101→	}
  1102→
  1103→	if !confirm {
  1104→		fmt.Println("Reset cancelled. Session logs were still restored.")
  1105→		printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1106→		return nil
  1107→	}
  1108→
  1109→	// Perform git reset --hard
  1110→	if err := performGitResetHard(point.ID); err != nil {
  1111→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during git reset",
  1112→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1113→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1114→		)
  1115→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reset branch: %w", err)
  1116→	}
  1117→
  1118→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset (interactive) completed",
  1119→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1120→	)
  1121→
  1122→	fmt.Printf("Reset branch to %s.\n", shortID)
  1123→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1124→
  1125→	// Show recovery instructions
  1126→	if currentHead != "" && currentHead != point.ID {
  1127→		currentShort := currentHead
  1128→		if len(currentShort) > 7 {
  1129→			currentShort = currentShort[:7]
  1130→		}
  1131→		fmt.Printf("\nTo undo this reset: git reset --hard %s\n", currentShort)
  1132→	}
  1133→
  1134→	return nil
  1135→}
  1136→
  1137→// getCurrentHeadHash returns the current HEAD commit hash.
  1138→func getCurrentHeadHash() (string, error) {
  1139→	repo, err := openRepository()
  1140→	if err != nil {
  1141→		return "", err
  1142→	}
  1143→
  1144→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1145→	if err != nil {
  1146→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
  1147→	}
  1148→
  1149→	return head.Hash().String(), nil
  1150→}
  1151→
  1152→// checkResetSafety checks for potential issues before a git reset --hard.
  1153→// Returns a list of warning messages (empty if safe to proceed without warnings).
  1154→// If uncommittedChangesWarning is provided, it will be used instead of a generic warning.
  1155→func checkResetSafety(targetCommitHash string, uncommittedChangesWarning string) ([]string, error) {
  1156→	var warnings []string
  1157→
  1158→	repo, err := openRepository()
  1159→	if err != nil {
  1160→		return nil, err
  1161→	}
  1162→
  1163→	// Check for uncommitted changes
  1164→	if uncommittedChangesWarning != "" {
  1165→		// Use the detailed warning from strategy's CanRewind()
  1166→		warnings = append(warnings, uncommittedChangesWarning)
  1167→	} else {
  1168→		// Fall back to generic check
  1169→		worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1170→		if err != nil {
  1171→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree: %w", err)
  1172→		}
  1173→
  1174→		status, err := worktree.Status()
  1175→		if err != nil {
  1176→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get status: %w", err)
  1177→		}
  1178→
  1179→		if !status.IsClean() {
  1180→			warnings = append(warnings, "• You have uncommitted changes that will be LOST")
  1181→		}
  1182→	}
  1183→
  1184→	// Check if current HEAD is ahead of target (we'd be discarding commits)
  1185→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1186→	if err != nil {
  1187→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
  1188→	}
  1189→
  1190→	targetHash := plumbing.NewHash(targetCommitHash)
  1191→
  1192→	// Count commits between target and HEAD
  1193→	commitsAhead, err := countCommitsBetween(repo, targetHash, head.Hash())
  1194→	if err != nil {
  1195→		// Non-fatal - just can't show commit count
  1196→		commitsAhead = -1
  1197→	}
  1198→
  1199→	if commitsAhead > 0 {
  1200→		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("• %d commit(s) after this point will be orphaned", commitsAhead))
  1201→	}
  1202→
  1203→	return warnings, nil
  1204→}
  1205→
  1206→// countCommitsBetween counts commits between ancestor and descendant.
  1207→// Returns 0 if ancestor == descendant, -1 on error.
  1208→func countCommitsBetween(repo *git.Repository, ancestor, descendant plumbing.Hash) (int, error) {
  1209→	if ancestor == descendant {
  1210→		return 0, nil
  1211→	}
  1212→
  1213→	// Walk from descendant back to ancestor
  1214→	count := 0
  1215→	current := descendant
  1216→
  1217→	for count < 1000 { // Safety limit
  1218→		if current == ancestor {
  1219→			return count, nil
  1220→		}
  1221→
  1222→		commit, err := repo.CommitObject(current)
  1223→		if err != nil {
  1224→			return -1, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
  1225→		}
  1226→
  1227→		if commit.NumParents() == 0 {
  1228→			// Reached root without finding ancestor - ancestor not in history
  1229→			return -1, nil
  1230→		}
  1231→
  1232→		count++
  1233→		current = commit.ParentHashes[0] // Follow first parent
  1234→	}
  1235→
  1236→	return -1, nil
  1237→}
  1238→
  1239→// performGitResetHard performs a git reset --hard to the specified commit.
  1240→// Uses the git CLI instead of go-git because go-git's HardReset incorrectly
  1241→// deletes untracked directories (like .entire/) even when they're in .gitignore.
  1242→func performGitResetHard(commitHash string) error {
  1243→	ctx := context.Background()
  1244→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "reset", "--hard", commitHash)
  1245→	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
  1246→		return fmt.Errorf("reset failed: %s: %w", strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), err)
  1247→	}
  1248→	return nil
  1249→}
  1250→
  1251→// extractSessionIDFromLogsOnlyPoint extracts the session ID from a logs-only point.
  1252→func extractSessionIDFromLogsOnlyPoint(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) string {
  1253→	// Try to get from condensation metadata via strategy
  1254→	if sv, ok := start.(*strategy.ManualCommitStrategy); ok {
  1255→		// The getSessionIDFromCondensation method is not exported, so we'll
  1256→		// extract from the commit's Entire-Session trailer instead
  1257→		_ = sv // Avoid unused variable error
  1258→	}
  1259→
  1260→	// Extract from commit's Entire-Session trailer
  1261→	repo, err := openRepository()
  1262→	if err != nil {
  1263→		return ""
  1264→	}
  1265→
  1266→	hash, err := repo.ResolveRevision(plumbing.Revision(point.ID))
  1267→	if err != nil {
  1268→		return ""
  1269→	}
  1270→
  1271→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(*hash)
  1272→	if err != nil {
  1273→		return ""
  1274→	}
  1275→
  1276→	// Parse Entire-Session trailer
  1277→	sessionID, found := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
  1278→	if found {
  1279→		return sessionID
  1280→	}
  1281→
  1282→	return ""
  1283→}
  1284→
  1285→// sanitizeForTerminal removes or replaces characters that cause rendering issues
  1286→// in terminal UI components. This includes emojis with skin-tone modifiers and
  1287→// other multi-codepoint characters that confuse width calculations.
  1288→func sanitizeForTerminal(s string) string {
  1289→	var result strings.Builder
  1290→	result.Grow(len(s))
  1291→
  1292→	for _, r := range s {
  1293→		// Skip emoji skin tone modifiers (U+1F3FB to U+1F3FF)
  1294→		if r >= 0x1F3FB && r <= 0x1F3FF {
  1295→			continue
  1296→		}
  1297→		// Skip zero-width joiners used in emoji sequences
  1298→		if r == 0x200D {
  1299→			continue
  1300→		}
  1301→		// Skip variation selectors (U+FE00 to U+FE0F)
  1302→		if r >= 0xFE00 && r <= 0xFE0F {
  1303→			continue
  1304→		}
  1305→		// Keep printable characters and common whitespace
  1306→		if unicode.IsPrint(r) || r == '\t' || r == '\n' {
  1307→			result.WriteRune(r)
  1308→		}
  1309→	}
  1310→
  1311→	return result.String()
  1312→}
  1313→
  1314→// formatResumeCommand returns the agent-appropriate command to resume a session.
  1315→func formatResumeCommand(entireSessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) string {
  1316→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(entireSessionID)
  1317→	return agent.FormatResumeCommand(agentSessionID)
  1318→}
  1319→
  1320→// printMultiSessionResumeCommands prints resume commands for all sessions in a rewind point.
  1321→// For single-session checkpoints, prints a single resume command.
  1322→// For multi-session checkpoints, prints all sessions with prompts as comments.
  1323→func printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point strategy.RewindPoint, agent agentpkg.Agent) {
  1324→	// Check if this is a multi-session checkpoint
  1325→	if point.SessionCount > 1 && len(point.SessionIDs) > 1 {
  1326→		fmt.Printf("\nRestored %d sessions. Resume with:\n", point.SessionCount)
  1327→
  1328→		// Print each session with prompt as comment
  1329→		for i, sessionID := range point.SessionIDs {
  1330→			cmd := formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent)
  1331→
  1332→			// Get prompt for this session (if available)
  1333→			var prompt string
  1334→			if i < len(point.SessionPrompts) {
  1335→				prompt = point.SessionPrompts[i]
  1336→			}
  1337→
  1338→			// Add "(most recent)" label to the last session
  1339→			if i == len(point.SessionIDs)-1 {
  1340→				if prompt != "" {
  1341→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # %s (most recent)\n", cmd, prompt)
  1342→				} else {
  1343→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # (most recent)\n", cmd)
  1344→				}
  1345→			} else {
  1346→				if prompt != "" {
  1347→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # %s\n", cmd, prompt)
  1348→				} else {
  1349→					fmt.Printf("  %s\n", cmd)
  1350→				}
  1351→			}
  1352→		}
  1353→	} else {
  1354→		// Single session - use traditional format with prompt if available
  1355→		sessionID := point.SessionID
  1356→		if sessionID == "" && len(point.SessionIDs) > 0 {
  1357→			sessionID = point.SessionIDs[len(point.SessionIDs)-1]
  1358→		}
  1359→		if sessionID != "" {
  1360→			cmd := formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent)

The shadow branch transcript retrieval is now complete. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary

**Problem:** After moving `GetSessionLog` out of strategies to the checkpoint package, shadow branch checkpoints (uncommitted) couldn't restore their transcripts because:
- They don't have a valid `CheckpointID` (12-char hex)
- The old code fell back to the commit hash which failed `id.NewCheckpointID` validation
- Local file fallback only works for active sessions

**Solution:** Updated the transcript restoration flow in `rewind.go` to use a three-tier fallback:

1. **Checkpoint storage** - For committed checkpoints with a valid `CheckpointID`
2. **Shadow branch** - For uncommitted checkpoints (detected by 40-char commit hash in `ID`) using the new `restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow()` function
3. **Local file** - For active sessions where transcript is still on disk

**Key functions added/modified:**
- `checkpoint/temporary.go`: Added `GetTranscriptFromCommit()` to read transcripts from shadow branch commit trees
- `rewind.go`: Added `restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow()` and `writeTranscriptToAgentSession()` helper
- `rewind.go`: Updated both interactive and non-interactive rewind paths to use the three-tier fallback

     1→// Package id provides the CheckpointID type for identifying checkpoints.
     2→// This is a separate package to avoid import cycles between paths, trailers, and checkpoint.
     3→package id
     4→
     5→import (
     6→	"crypto/rand"
     7→	"encoding/hex"
     8→	"fmt"
     9→	"regexp"
    10→)
    11→
    12→// CheckpointID is a 12-character hex identifier for checkpoints.
    13→// It's used to link code commits to metadata on the entire/sessions branch.
    14→type CheckpointID string
    15→
    16→// EmptyCheckpointID represents an unset or invalid checkpoint ID.
    17→const EmptyCheckpointID CheckpointID = ""
    18→
    19→// Pattern is the regex pattern for a valid checkpoint ID: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.
    20→// Exported for use in other packages (e.g., trailers) to avoid pattern duplication.
    21→const Pattern = `[0-9a-f]{12}`
    22→
    23→// checkpointIDRegex validates the format: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.
    24→var checkpointIDRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`^` + Pattern + `$`)
    25→
    26→// NewCheckpointID creates a CheckpointID from a string, validating its format.
    27→// Returns an error if the string is not a valid 12-character hex ID.
    28→func NewCheckpointID(s string) (CheckpointID, error) {
    29→	if err := Validate(s); err != nil {
    30→		return EmptyCheckpointID, err
    31→	}
    32→	return CheckpointID(s), nil
    33→}
    34→
    35→// MustCheckpointID creates a CheckpointID from a string, panicking if invalid.
    36→// Use only when the ID is known to be valid (e.g., from trusted sources).
    37→func MustCheckpointID(s string) CheckpointID {
    38→	id, err := NewCheckpointID(s)
    39→	if err != nil {
    40→		panic(err)
    41→	}
    42→	return id
    43→}
    44→
    45→// Generate creates a new random 12-character hex checkpoint ID.
    46→func Generate() CheckpointID {
    47→	bytes := make([]byte, 6) // 6 bytes = 12 hex chars
    48→	if _, err := rand.Read(bytes); err != nil {
    49→		panic(fmt.Sprintf("failed to generate random checkpoint ID: %v", err))
    50→	}
    51→	return CheckpointID(hex.EncodeToString(bytes))
    52→}
    53→
    54→// Validate checks if a string is a valid checkpoint ID format.
    55→// Returns an error if invalid, nil if valid.
    56→func Validate(s string) error {
    57→	if !checkpointIDRegex.MatchString(s) {
    58→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint ID %q: must be 12 lowercase hex characters", s)
    59→	}
    60→	return nil
    61→}
    62→
    63→// String returns the checkpoint ID as a string.
    64→func (id CheckpointID) String() string {
    65→	return string(id)
    66→}
    67→
    68→// IsEmpty returns true if the checkpoint ID is empty or unset.
    69→func (id CheckpointID) IsEmpty() bool {
    70→	return id == EmptyCheckpointID
    71→}
    72→
    73→// Path returns the sharded path for this checkpoint ID on entire/sessions.
    74→// Uses first 2 characters as shard (256 buckets), remaining as folder name.
    75→// Example: "a3b2c4d5e6f7" -> "a3/b2c4d5e6f7"
    76→func (id CheckpointID) Path() string {
    77→	if len(id) < 3 {
    78→		return string(id)
    79→	}
    80→	return string(id[:2]) + "/" + string(id[2:])
    81→}
    82→

All tests pass and no lint issues. Here's a summary of the changes to use typed `id.CheckpointID`:

## Summary

Updated `RewindPoint.CheckpointID` and `Checkpoint.CheckpointID` from `string` to `id.CheckpointID`.

### Files modified:

**Type definitions:**
- `strategy/strategy.go` - Changed `RewindPoint.CheckpointID` from `string` to `id.CheckpointID`
- `strategy/session.go` - Changed `Checkpoint.CheckpointID` from `string` to `id.CheckpointID`

**Strategy implementations:**
- `strategy/auto_commit.go` - Updated comparisons to use `.IsEmpty()` and calls to use `.String()` or `.Path()`
- `strategy/manual_commit_logs.go` - Same pattern
- `strategy/manual_commit_rewind.go` - Convert JSON strings to typed ID when creating `RewindPoint`
- `strategy/session.go` - Convert strings when building `Checkpoint` structs

**CLI commands:**
- `rewind.go` - Updated `restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy` to take typed ID, use `.IsEmpty()` for checks
- `session.go` - Updated `restoreAgentSession` to take typed ID
- `resume.go` - Convert string to typed ID when creating `RewindPoint`
- `explain.go` - Use `.String()` for display

**Tests:**
- `strategy/session_test.go` - Use `.String()` for comparison

### Benefits:
- Type safety: Invalid checkpoint IDs caught at compile time
- Cleaner API: Functions accepting `id.CheckpointID` don't need internal validation
- Readable code: `.IsEmpty()` is more expressive than `!= ""`
- Consistent: Typed IDs used throughout the codebase

- Import statements (`checkpoint/id` package)

1. Uses typed `id.CheckpointID` in `RewindPoint` and `Checkpoint` structs
2. Moves session log lookup from strategies to the `checkpoint` package
3. Adds shadow branch transcript retrieval for uncommitted checkpoints

   158→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   159→// startLine specifies the first line to include (0 = all lines, for incremental condensation).
   160→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   161→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   162→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, startLine int, filesTouched []string, agentType string) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   163→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   164→	if err != nil {
   165→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   166→	}
   167→
   168→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   169→	if err != nil {
   170→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   171→	}
   172→
   173→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   174→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix), so construct path directly
   175→	// Don't use paths.SessionMetadataDir which would add another date prefix
   176→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + sessionID
   177→
   178→	// Extract transcript
   179→	var fullTranscript string
   180→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   181→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   182→			fullTranscript = content
   183→		}
   184→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   185→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   186→			fullTranscript = content
   187→		}
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   191→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   192→		// Check if this is a Gemini CLI transcript (JSON format, not JSONL)
   193→		isGeminiFormat := strings.Contains(agentType, "Gemini") || isGeminiJSONTranscript(fullTranscript)
   194→
   195→		if isGeminiFormat {
   196→			// Gemini uses JSON format with a "messages" array
   197→			data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   198→			data.FullTranscriptLines = 1 // JSON is a single "line"
   199→			data.Prompts = extractUserPromptsFromGeminiJSON(fullTranscript)
   200→			data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   201→		} else {
   202→			// Claude Code and others use JSONL format (one JSON object per line)
   203→			allLines := strings.Split(fullTranscript, "\n")
   204→
   205→			// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   206→			for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   207→				allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   208→			}
   209→
   210→			data.FullTranscriptLines = len(allLines)
   211→
   212→			// Get only lines from startLine onwards for this condensation
   213→			if startLine < len(allLines) {
   214→				newLines := allLines[startLine:]
   215→				data.Transcript = []byte(strings.Join(newLines, "\n"))
   216→
   217→				// Extract prompts from the new portion only
   218→				data.Prompts = extractUserPromptsFromLines(newLines)
   219→
   220→				// Generate context from prompts
   221→				data.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)
   222→			}
   223→		}
   224→	}
   225→
   226→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   227→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   228→
   229→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   230→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   231→		transcriptLines, err := claudecode.ParseTranscript(data.Transcript)
   232→		if err == nil && len(transcriptLines) > 0 {
   233→			data.TokenUsage = claudecode.CalculateTokenUsage(transcriptLines)
   234→		}
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	return data, nil
   238→}
   239→
   240→// isGeminiJSONTranscript detects if the transcript is in Gemini's JSON format.
   241→// Gemini transcripts start with a JSON object containing a "messages" array.
   242→func isGeminiJSONTranscript(content string) bool {
   243→	content = strings.TrimSpace(content)
   244→	// Quick check: Gemini JSON starts with { and contains "messages"
   245→	if !strings.HasPrefix(content, "{") {
   246→		return false
   247→	}
   248→	// Try to parse as Gemini format
   249→	var transcript struct {
   250→		Messages []json.RawMessage `json:"messages"`
   251→	}
   252→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &transcript); err != nil {
   253→		return false
   254→	}
   255→	return len(transcript.Messages) > 0
   256→}
   257→
   258→// extractUserPromptsFromGeminiJSON extracts user prompts from Gemini's JSON transcript format.
   259→// Gemini transcripts are structured as: {"messages": [{"type": "user", "content": "..."}, ...]}
   260→func extractUserPromptsFromGeminiJSON(content string) []string {
   261→	var transcript struct {
   262→		Messages []struct {
   263→			Type    string `json:"type"`
   264→			Content string `json:"content"`
   265→		} `json:"messages"`
   266→	}
   267→
   268→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &transcript); err != nil {
   269→		return nil
   270→	}
   271→
   272→	var prompts []string
   273→	for _, msg := range transcript.Messages {
   274→		if msg.Type == "user" && msg.Content != "" {
   275→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   276→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(msg.Content)
   277→			if cleaned != "" {
   278→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   279→			}
   280→		}
   281→	}
   282→
   283→	return prompts
   284→}
   285→
   286→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   287→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   288→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   289→	var prompts []string
   290→	for _, line := range lines {
   291→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   292→		if line == "" {
   293→			continue
   294→		}
   295→
   296→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   297→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   298→			continue
   299→		}
   300→
   301→		// Check for user message (supports both "human" and "user" types)
   302→		msgType, ok := entry["type"].(string)
   303→		if !ok || (msgType != "human" && msgType != "user") {
   304→			continue
   305→		}
   306→
   307→		// Extract message content
   308→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   309→		if !ok {
   310→			continue
   311→		}
   312→
   313→		// Handle string content
   314→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   315→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   316→			if cleaned != "" {
   317→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   318→			}
   319→			continue
   320→		}
   321→
   322→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   323→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   324→			var texts []string
   325→			for _, item := range arr {
   326→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   327→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   328→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   329→							texts = append(texts, text)
   330→						}
   331→					}
   332→				}
   333→			}
   334→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   335→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   336→				if cleaned != "" {
   337→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   338→				}
   339→			}
   340→		}
   341→	}
   342→	return prompts
   343→}
   344→
   345→// generateContextFromPrompts generates context.md content from a list of prompts.
   346→func generateContextFromPrompts(prompts []string) []byte {
   347→	if len(prompts) == 0 {
   348→		return nil
   349→	}
   350→
   351→	var buf strings.Builder
   352→	buf.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   353→	buf.WriteString("## User Prompts\n\n")
   354→
   355→	for i, prompt := range prompts {
   356→		// Truncate very long prompts for readability
   357→		displayPrompt := prompt
   358→		if len(displayPrompt) > 500 {
   359→			displayPrompt = displayPrompt[:500] + "..."
   360→		}
   361→		buf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### Prompt %d\n\n", i+1))
   362→		buf.WriteString(displayPrompt)
   363→		buf.WriteString("\n\n")
   364→	}
   365→
   366→	return []byte(buf.String())
   367→}

I see the issue. In `extractSessionData` (lines 212-222), when processing JSONL transcripts, only lines from `startLine` onwards are extracted:

```go
// Get only lines from startLine onwards for this condensation
if startLine < len(allLines) {
    newLines := allLines[startLine:]
    data.Transcript = []byte(strings.Join(newLines, "\n"))
```

The `startLine` comes from `state.CondensedTranscriptLines`, which tracks how many lines were already condensed. This means incremental condensations only store the **delta**, not the full transcript.

Let me check how `CondensedTranscriptLines` is updated after condensation.

> AGENT

I found the issue. In `extractSessionData` (manual_commit_condensation.go:212-222), when `startLine > 0` (i.e., after the first condensation), only the **new lines** since the last condensation are stored:

```go
// Get only lines from startLine onwards for this condensation
if startLine < len(allLines) {
    newLines := allLines[startLine:]
    data.Transcript = []byte(strings.Join(newLines, "\n"))
```

The flow is:
1. **First commit** (`CondensedTranscriptLines = 0`): Full transcript stored (lines 0→N)
2. **Second commit** (`CondensedTranscriptLines = N`): Only delta stored (lines N→M)
3. **Third commit** (`CondensedTranscriptLines = M`): Only delta stored (lines M→P)

So when looking up a checkpoint from the 2nd+ commit, you only get the delta, not the full transcript.

The fix is simple - always store the full transcript. Let me update `extractSessionData` to always use all lines while still tracking the line counts for detecting new content.

> TOOL

  "new_string": "\t\t// Claude Code and others use JSONL format (one JSON object per line)\n\t\t\tallLines := strings.Split(fullTranscript, \"\\n\")\n\n\t\t\t// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \\n in JSONL)\n\t\t\tfor len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tallLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tdata.FullTranscriptLines = len(allLines)\n\n\t\t\t// Always store the full transcript for complete session history\n\t\t\t// (startLine is only used for detecting new content, not for truncation)\n\t\t\tdata.Transcript = []byte(strings.Join(allLines, \"\\n\"))\n\n\t\t\t// Extract prompts from the full transcript\n\t\t\tdata.Prompts = extractUserPromptsFromLines(allLines)\n\n\t\t\t// Generate context from prompts\n\t\t\tdata.Context = generateContextFromPrompts(data.Prompts)"
}

> AGENT

**Summary of the fix:**

1. **Before**: `extractSessionData` would only extract lines from `startLine` onwards, storing only the delta since the last condensation
2. **After**: Always extracts and stores the full transcript regardless of `CondensedTranscriptLines`

The `CondensedTranscriptLines` field in `SessionState` is still used for:
- Detecting whether there's new content to condense (in `sessionHasNewContent`)
- Tracking transcript position for incremental processing

But it's no longer used to truncate what gets stored - each checkpoint now contains the complete transcript.

   260→	}

    37→// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    38→// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    39→// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    40→// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    41→// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    42→func (s *GitStore) WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error) {
    43→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use (e.g., cancellation)
    44→
    45→	// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    46→	if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    47→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    48→	}
    49→
    50→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    51→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    52→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	// Get shadow branch name
    56→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit)
    57→
    58→	// Get or create shadow branch
    59→	parentHash, baseTreeHash, err := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName)
    60→	if err != nil {
    61→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", err)
    62→	}
    63→
    64→	// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
    65→	var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
    66→	if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
    67→		if lastCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); err == nil {
    68→			lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
    69→		}
    70→	}
    71→
    72→	// Collect all files to include
    73→	var allFiles []string
    74→	if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    75→		// For the first checkpoint of this session, capture ALL files in working directory
    76→		// This ensures untracked files present at session start are included
    77→		allFiles, err = collectWorkingDirectoryFiles()
    78→		if err != nil {
    79→			return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect working directory files: %w", err)
    80→		}
    81→	} else {
    82→		// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files
    83→		allFiles = make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
    84→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
    85→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	// Build tree with changes
    89→	treeHash, err := s.buildTreeWithChanges(baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
    90→	if err != nil {
    91→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
    92→	}
    93→
    94→	// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the last checkpoint
    95→	if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
    96→		return WriteTemporaryResult{
    97→			CommitHash: parentHash,
    98→			Skipped:    true,
    99→		}, nil
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	// Create checkpoint commit with trailers
   103→	commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   104→
   105→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
   108→	}

> AGENT

All tests pass. Here's the summary:

**Finding**: The only place with transcript truncation was in `manual_commit_condensation.go:extractSessionData()`, which I fixed. 

**Both strategies now store full transcripts in all cases:**

| Strategy | Checkpoint Type | How Transcript is Stored |
|----------|-----------------|-------------------------|
| **auto-commit** | Regular (SaveChanges) | `MetadataDir` → copies full file from disk |
| **auto-commit** | Task | `TranscriptPath` → reads full file from disk |
| **manual-commit** | Shadow (SaveChanges) | `MetadataDirAbs` → copies full file from disk |
| **manual-commit** | Task | `TranscriptPath` → reads full file from disk |
| **manual-commit** | Condensation | `Transcript` field → **now full content** (was truncated) |

The `CondensedTranscriptLines` field is still tracked and used for:
- Detecting when there's new content to condense
- Calculating token usage from the new portion only

But it no longer affects what gets stored - every checkpoint now contains the complete transcript.

Good thinking. Let me plan this out:

1. **Chunking threshold**: ~50MB per chunk (safe margin under GitHub's 100MB limit)
2. **Agent-specific splitting**:
   - **JSONL (Claude Code)**: Split at line boundaries
   - **JSON (Gemini)**: Split the messages array
3. **Storage format**: `full.jsonl`, `full.jsonl.001`, `full.jsonl.002`, etc.
4. **Reading**: Detect chunks and reassemble transparently

    44→// Type indicates the storage location and lifecycle of a checkpoint.

    50→	Temporary Type = iota

    52→	// Committed checkpoints contain metadata + commit reference and are stored

    57→// Store provides low-level primitives for reading and writing checkpoints.

    60→// The interface matches the GitStore implementation signatures directly:

    63→// - List methods return implementation-specific info types for richer data
    64→type Store interface {
    65→	// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint (full state) to a shadow branch.
    66→	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    67→	// Returns a result containing the commit hash and whether the checkpoint was skipped.

    69→	WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error)

    71→	// ReadTemporary reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.

    76→	// ListTemporary lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.

    79→	// WriteCommitted writes a committed checkpoint to the entire/sessions branch.

    87→	// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints.

  "new_string": "// writeTranscript writes the transcript file from in-memory content or file path.\n// If the transcript exceeds MaxChunkSize, it's split into multiple chunk files.\nfunc (s *GitStore) writeTranscript(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {\n\ttranscript := opts.Transcript\n\tif len(transcript) == 0 && opts.TranscriptPath != \"\" {\n\t\tvar readErr error\n\t\ttranscript, readErr = os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath)\n\t\tif readErr != nil {\n\t\t\t// Non-fatal: transcript may not exist yet\n\t\t\ttranscript = nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(transcript) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Chunk the transcript if it's too large\n\tchunks, err := ChunkTranscript(transcript, opts.Agent)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to chunk transcript: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Write chunk files\n\tfor i, chunk := range chunks {\n\t\tchunkPath := basePath + ChunkFileName(paths.TranscriptFileName, i)\n\t\tblobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, chunk)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tentries[chunkPath] = object.TreeEntry{\n\t\t\tName: chunkPath,\n\t\t\tMode: filemode.Regular,\n\t\t\tHash: blobHash,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Content hash for deduplication (hash of full transcript)\n\tcontentHash := fmt.Sprintf(\"sha256:%x\", sha256.Sum256(transcript))\n\thashBlob, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(contentHash))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tentries[basePath+paths.ContentHashFileName] = object.TreeEntry{\n\t\tName: basePath + paths.ContentHashFileName,\n\t\tMode: filemode.Regular,\n\t\tHash: hashBlob,\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}"
}

  "new_string": "// GetTranscriptFromCommit retrieves the transcript from a specific commit's tree.\n// This is used for shadow branch checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the commit tree\n// rather than on the entire/sessions branch.\n// commitHash is the commit to read from, metadataDir is the path within the tree.\n// Handles both chunked and non-chunked transcripts.\nfunc (s *GitStore) GetTranscriptFromCommit(commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) ([]byte, error) {\n\tcommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(commitHash)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get commit: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\ttree, err := commit.Tree()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get commit tree: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Try to get the metadata subtree for chunk detection\n\tsubTree, subTreeErr := tree.Tree(metadataDir)\n\tif subTreeErr == nil {\n\t\t// Use the helper function that handles chunking\n\t\ttranscript, err := readTranscriptFromTreeWithPrefix(tree, metadataDir, \"\")\n\t\tif err == nil && transcript != nil {\n\t\t\treturn transcript, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Fall back to direct file access (for backwards compatibility)\n\ttranscriptPath := metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileName\n\tif file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {\n\t\tcontent, contentErr := file.Contents()\n\t\tif contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\treturn []byte(content), nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\ttranscriptPath = metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy\n\tif file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {\n\t\tcontent, contentErr := file.Contents()\n\t\tif contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\treturn []byte(content), nil\n\t\t}\n\t}"
}

All tests pass and the linter reports 0 issues. The transcript chunking implementation is complete and verified:

**Summary of completed work:**

1. **`chunking.go`** - Core chunking/reassembly logic:
   - `ChunkTranscript()` - splits transcripts >50MB into chunks
   - `ReassembleTranscript()` - combines chunks back together
   - JSONL (Claude Code) splits at line boundaries
   - Gemini JSON splits the messages array
   - Chunk naming: `full.jsonl`, `full.jsonl.001`, `full.jsonl.002`, etc.

2. **`committed.go`** - Updated for `entire/sessions` branch:
   - `writeTranscript()` now chunks large transcripts
   - `readTranscriptFromTree()` helper reassembles chunks when reading
   - Backwards compatible with non-chunked transcripts

3. **`temporary.go`** - Updated for shadow branches:
   - Shadow branch writing supports chunking
   - `GetTranscriptFromCommit()` handles chunked transcripts

4. **`chunking_test.go`** - Comprehensive tests for:
   - Small/large JSONL transcripts
   - Small/large Gemini JSON transcripts
   - Filename parsing and sorting
   - Reassembly edge cases

The 50MB chunk size provides a safe margin under GitHub's 100MB blob limit.

    10→// Agent defines the interface for interacting with a coding agent.
    11→// Each agent implementation (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, etc.) converts its
    12→// native format to the normalized types defined in this package.
    13→type Agent interface {
    14→	// Name returns the agent identifier (e.g., "claude-code", "cursor")
    15→	Name() string
    16→

    23→	// GetHookConfigPath returns path to hook config file (empty if none)

    25→
    26→	// SupportsHooks returns true if agent supports lifecycle hooks

    29→	// ParseHookInput parses hook callback input from stdin
    30→	ParseHookInput(hookType HookType, reader io.Reader) (*HookInput, error)
    31→
    32→	// GetSessionID extracts session ID from hook input

    34→
    35→	// TransformSessionID converts agent session ID to Entire session ID
    36→	TransformSessionID(agentSessionID string) string
    37→
    38→	// ExtractAgentSessionID extracts agent session ID from Entire ID
    39→	ExtractAgentSessionID(entireSessionID string) string
    40→
    41→	// GetSessionDir returns where agent stores session data for this repo.
    42→	// Examples:
    43→	//   Claude: ~/.claude/projects/<sanitized-repo-path>/
    44→	//   Aider: current working directory (returns repoPath)
    45→	//   Cursor: ~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/
    46→	GetSessionDir(repoPath string) (string, error)
    47→
    48→	// ReadSession reads session data from agent's storage.
    49→	// Handles different formats: JSONL (Claude), SQLite (Cursor), Markdown (Aider)
    50→	ReadSession(input *HookInput) (*AgentSession, error)
    51→
    52→	// WriteSession writes session data for resumption.
    53→	// Agent handles format conversion (JSONL, SQLite, etc.)
    54→	WriteSession(session *AgentSession) error
    55→

    57→	FormatResumeCommand(sessionID string) string
    58→}
    59→
    60→// HookSupport is implemented by agents with lifecycle hooks.
    61→// This optional interface allows agents like Claude Code and Cursor to
    62→// install and manage hooks that notify Entire of agent events.
    63→type HookSupport interface {
    64→	Agent
    65→
    66→	// InstallHooks installs agent-specific hooks.
    67→	// If localDev is true, hooks point to local development build.
    68→	// If force is true, removes existing Entire hooks before installing.

    78→	// GetSupportedHooks returns the hook types this agent supports

    80→}
    81→
    82→// HookHandler is implemented by agents that define their own hook vocabulary.
    83→// Each agent defines its own hook names (verbs) which become subcommands
    84→// under `entire hooks <agent>`. The actual handling is done by handlers
    85→// registered in the CLI package to avoid circular dependencies.
    86→//
    87→// This allows different agents to have completely different hook vocabularies
    88→// (e.g., Claude Code has "stop", Cursor might have "completion").
    89→type HookHandler interface {
    90→	Agent

    92→	// GetHookNames returns the hook verbs this agent supports.

    15→// Transcript parsing types - Claude Code uses JSONL format
    16→
    17→// TranscriptLine represents a single line in Claude's JSONL transcript
    18→type TranscriptLine struct {
    19→	Type    string          `json:"type"`
    20→	UUID    string          `json:"uuid"`
    21→	Message json.RawMessage `json:"message"`
    22→}
    23→
    24→// userMessage represents a user message in the transcript
    25→type userMessage struct {
    26→	Content interface{} `json:"content"`
    27→}
    28→
    29→// assistantMessage represents an assistant message in the transcript
    30→type assistantMessage struct {
    31→	Content []contentBlock `json:"content"`
    32→}
    33→
    34→// contentBlock represents a block within an assistant message
    35→type contentBlock struct {
    36→	Type  string          `json:"type"`
    37→	Text  string          `json:"text,omitempty"`
    38→	Name  string          `json:"name,omitempty"`
    39→	Input json.RawMessage `json:"input,omitempty"`
    40→}
    41→
    42→// toolInput represents the input to file modification tools
    43→type toolInput struct {
    44→	FilePath     string `json:"file_path,omitempty"`
    45→	NotebookPath string `json:"notebook_path,omitempty"`
    46→}
    47→
    48→// Scanner buffer size for large transcript files (10MB)
    49→const scannerBufferSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024
    50→
    51→// ParseTranscript parses raw JSONL content into transcript lines
    52→func ParseTranscript(data []byte) ([]TranscriptLine, error) {
    53→	var lines []TranscriptLine
    54→	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(data))
    55→	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, scannerBufferSize), scannerBufferSize)
    56→
    57→	for scanner.Scan() {
    58→		var line TranscriptLine
    59→		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &line); err != nil {
    60→			continue // Skip malformed lines
    61→		}
    62→		lines = append(lines, line)
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
    66→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan transcript: %w", err)
    67→	}
    68→	return lines, nil
    69→}
    70→
    71→// SerializeTranscript converts transcript lines back to JSONL bytes
    72→func SerializeTranscript(lines []TranscriptLine) ([]byte, error) {
    73→	var buf bytes.Buffer
    74→	for _, line := range lines {
    75→		data, err := json.Marshal(line)
    76→		if err != nil {
    77→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal line: %w", err)
    78→		}
    79→		buf.Write(data)
    80→		buf.WriteByte('\n')
    81→	}
    82→	return buf.Bytes(), nil
    83→}
    84→
    85→// ExtractModifiedFiles extracts files modified by tool calls from transcript
    86→func ExtractModifiedFiles(lines []TranscriptLine) []string {
    87→	fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
    88→	var files []string
    89→
    90→	for _, line := range lines {
    91→		if line.Type != "assistant" {
    92→			continue
    93→		}
    94→
    95→		var msg assistantMessage
    96→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line.Message, &msg); err != nil {
    97→			continue
    98→		}
    99→
   100→		for _, block := range msg.Content {
   101→			if block.Type != "tool_use" {
   102→				continue
   103→			}
   104→
   105→			// Check if it's a file modification tool
   106→			isModifyTool := false
   107→			for _, name := range FileModificationTools {
   108→				if block.Name == name {
   109→					isModifyTool = true
   110→					break
   111→				}
   112→			}
   113→
   114→			if !isModifyTool {
   115→				continue
   116→			}
   117→
   118→			var input toolInput
   119→			if err := json.Unmarshal(block.Input, &input); err != nil {
   120→				continue
   121→			}
   122→
   123→			file := input.FilePath
   124→			if file == "" {
   125→				file = input.NotebookPath
   126→			}
   127→
   128→			if file != "" && !fileSet[file] {
   129→				fileSet[file] = true
   130→				files = append(files, file)
   131→			}
   132→		}
   133→	}
   134→
   135→	return files
   136→}
   137→
   138→// ExtractLastUserPrompt extracts the last user message from transcript
   139→func ExtractLastUserPrompt(lines []TranscriptLine) string {
   140→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   141→		if lines[i].Type != "user" {
   142→			continue
   143→		}
   144→
   145→		var msg userMessage
   146→		if err := json.Unmarshal(lines[i].Message, &msg); err != nil {
