   149→
   150→		// Handle string content
   151→		if str, ok := msg.Content.(string); ok {
   152→			return str
   153→		}
   154→
   155→		// Handle array content (text blocks)
   156→		if arr, ok := msg.Content.([]interface{}); ok {
   157→			var texts []string
   158→			for _, item := range arr {
   159→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   160→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   161→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   162→							texts = append(texts, text)
   163→						}
   164→					}
   165→				}
   166→			}
   167→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   168→				return strings.Join(texts, "\n\n")
   169→			}
   170→		}
   171→	}
   172→	return ""
   173→}
   174→
   175→// TruncateAtUUID returns transcript lines up to and including the line with given UUID
   176→func TruncateAtUUID(lines []TranscriptLine, uuid string) []TranscriptLine {
   177→	if uuid == "" {
   178→		return lines
   179→	}
   180→
   181→	for i, line := range lines {
   182→		if line.UUID == uuid {
   183→			return lines[:i+1]
   184→		}
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// UUID not found, return full transcript
   188→	return lines
   189→}
   190→
   191→// toolResultBlock represents a tool_result in a user message
   192→type toolResultBlock struct {
   193→	Type      string `json:"type"`
   194→	ToolUseID string `json:"tool_use_id"`
   195→}
   196→
   197→// userMessageWithToolResults represents a user message that may contain tool results
   198→type userMessageWithToolResults struct {
   199→	Content []toolResultBlock `json:"content"`
   200→}
   201→
   202→// FindCheckpointUUID finds the UUID of the message containing the tool_result
   203→// for the given tool_use_id
   204→func FindCheckpointUUID(lines []TranscriptLine, toolUseID string) (string, bool) {
   205→	for _, line := range lines {
   206→		if line.Type != "user" {
   207→			continue
   208→		}
   209→
   210→		var msg userMessageWithToolResults
   211→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line.Message, &msg); err != nil {
   212→			continue
   213→		}
   214→
   215→		for _, block := range msg.Content {
   216→			if block.Type == "tool_result" && block.ToolUseID == toolUseID {
   217→				return line.UUID, true
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→	}
   221→	return "", false
   222→}
   223→
   224→// CalculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from a Claude Code transcript.
   225→// This is specific to Claude/Anthropic's API format where each assistant message
   226→// contains a usage object with input_tokens, output_tokens, and cache tokens.
   227→//
   228→// Due to streaming, multiple transcript rows may share the same message.id.
   229→// We deduplicate by taking the row with the highest output_tokens for each message.id.
   230→func CalculateTokenUsage(transcript []TranscriptLine) *checkpoint.TokenUsage {
   231→	// Map from message.id to the usage with highest output_tokens
   232→	usageByMessageID := make(map[string]messageUsage)
   233→
   234→	for _, line := range transcript {
   235→		if line.Type != "assistant" {
   236→			continue
   237→		}
   238→
   239→		var msg messageWithUsage
   240→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line.Message, &msg); err != nil {
   241→			continue
   242→		}
   243→
   244→		if msg.ID == "" {
   245→			continue
   246→		}
   247→
   248→		// Keep the entry with highest output_tokens (final streaming state)
   249→		existing, exists := usageByMessageID[msg.ID]
   250→		if !exists || msg.Usage.OutputTokens > existing.OutputTokens {
   251→			usageByMessageID[msg.ID] = msg.Usage
   252→		}
   253→	}
   254→
   255→	// Sum up all unique messages
   256→	usage := &checkpoint.TokenUsage{
   257→		APICallCount: len(usageByMessageID),
   258→	}
   259→	for _, u := range usageByMessageID {
   260→		usage.InputTokens += u.InputTokens
   261→		usage.CacheCreationTokens += u.CacheCreationInputTokens
   262→		usage.CacheReadTokens += u.CacheReadInputTokens
   263→		usage.OutputTokens += u.OutputTokens
   264→	}
   265→
   266→	return usage
   267→}
   268→
   269→// CalculateTokenUsageFromFile calculates token usage from a Claude Code transcript file.
   270→// If startLine > 0, only considers lines from startLine onwards.
   271→func CalculateTokenUsageFromFile(path string, startLine int) (*checkpoint.TokenUsage, error) {
   272→	if path == "" {
   273→		return &checkpoint.TokenUsage{}, nil
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	transcript, err := parseTranscriptFromLine(path, startLine)
   277→	if err != nil {
   278→		return nil, err
   279→	}
   280→
   281→	return CalculateTokenUsage(transcript), nil
   282→}
   283→
   284→// parseTranscriptFromLine parses a transcript file starting from a specific line.
   285→func parseTranscriptFromLine(path string, startLine int) ([]TranscriptLine, error) {
   286→	file, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from Claude Code transcript location
   287→	if err != nil {
   288→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open transcript file: %w", err)
   289→	}
   290→	defer file.Close()
   291→
   292→	var lines []TranscriptLine
   293→	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
   294→	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, scannerBufferSize), scannerBufferSize)
   295→
   296→	lineNum := 0
   297→	for scanner.Scan() {
   298→		if lineNum < startLine {
   299→			lineNum++
   300→			continue
   301→		}
   302→		lineNum++
   303→
   304→		var line TranscriptLine
   305→		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &line); err != nil {
   306→			continue // Skip malformed lines
   307→		}
   308→		lines = append(lines, line)
   309→	}
   310→
   311→	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
   312→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan transcript: %w", err)
   313→	}
   314→
   315→	return lines, nil
   316→}
   317→
   318→// ExtractSpawnedAgentIDs extracts agent IDs from Task tool results in a transcript.
   319→// When a Task tool completes, the tool_result contains "agentId: <id>" in its content.
   320→// Returns a map of agentID -> toolUseID for all spawned agents.
   321→func ExtractSpawnedAgentIDs(transcript []TranscriptLine) map[string]string {
   322→	agentIDs := make(map[string]string)
   323→
   324→	for _, line := range transcript {
   325→		if line.Type != "user" {
   326→			continue
   327→		}
   328→
   329→		// Parse as array of content blocks (tool results)
   330→		var contentBlocks []struct {
   331→			Type      string          `json:"type"`
   332→			ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   333→			Content   json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
   334→		}
   335→
   336→		var msg struct {
   337→			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
   338→		}
   339→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line.Message, &msg); err != nil {
   340→			continue
   341→		}
   342→
   343→		if err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Content, &contentBlocks); err != nil {
   344→			continue
   345→		}
   346→
   347→		for _, block := range contentBlocks {
   348→			if block.Type != "tool_result" {
   349→				continue
   350→			}
   351→
   352→			// Content can be a string or array of text blocks
   353→			var textContent string
   354→
   355→			// Try as array of text blocks first
   356→			var textBlocks []struct {
   357→				Type string `json:"type"`
   358→				Text string `json:"text"`
   359→			}
   360→			if err := json.Unmarshal(block.Content, &textBlocks); err == nil {
   361→				var textContentSb361 strings.Builder
   362→				for _, tb := range textBlocks {
   363→					if tb.Type == "text" {
   364→						textContentSb361.WriteString(tb.Text + "\n")
   365→					}
   366→				}
   367→				textContent += textContentSb361.String()
   368→			} else {
   369→				// Try as plain string
   370→				var str string
   371→				if err := json.Unmarshal(block.Content, &str); err == nil {
   372→					textContent = str
   373→				}
   374→			}
   375→
   376→			// Look for agentId in the text
   377→			if agentID := extractAgentIDFromText(textContent); agentID != "" {
   378→				agentIDs[agentID] = block.ToolUseID
   379→			}
   380→		}
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	return agentIDs
   384→}
   385→
   386→// extractAgentIDFromText extracts an agent ID from text containing "agentId: <id>".
   387→func extractAgentIDFromText(text string) string {
   388→	const prefix = "agentId: "
   389→	idx := strings.Index(text, prefix)
   390→	if idx == -1 {
   391→		return ""
   392→	}
   393→
   394→	// Extract the ID (alphanumeric characters after the prefix)
   395→	start := idx + len(prefix)
   396→	end := start
   397→	for end < len(text) && (text[end] >= 'a' && text[end] <= 'z' ||
   398→		text[end] >= 'A' && text[end] <= 'Z' ||
   399→		text[end] >= '0' && text[end] <= '9') {
   400→		end++
   401→	}
   402→
   403→	if end > start {
   404→		return text[start:end]
   405→	}
   406→	return ""
   407→}
   408→
   409→// CalculateTotalTokenUsage calculates token usage for a turn, including subagents.
   410→// It parses the main transcript from startLine, extracts spawned agent IDs,
   411→// and calculates their token usage from transcripts in subagentsDir.
   412→func CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath string, startLine int, subagentsDir string) (*checkpoint.TokenUsage, error) {
   413→	// Calculate main transcript usage
   414→	mainUsage, err := CalculateTokenUsageFromFile(transcriptPath, startLine)
   415→	if err != nil {
   416→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to calculate main token usage: %w", err)
   417→	}
   418→
   419→	// Parse the transcript to find spawned agents
   420→	transcript, err := parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, startLine)
   421→	if err != nil {
   422→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript for agent IDs: %w", err)
   423→	}
   424→
   425→	agentIDs := ExtractSpawnedAgentIDs(transcript)
   426→
   427→	// Calculate subagent token usage
   428→	if len(agentIDs) > 0 {
   429→		subagentUsage := &checkpoint.TokenUsage{}
   430→		for agentID := range agentIDs {
   431→			agentPath := filepath.Join(subagentsDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.jsonl", agentID))
   432→			agentUsage, err := CalculateTokenUsageFromFile(agentPath, 0)
   433→			if err != nil {
   434→				// Agent transcript may not exist yet or may have been cleaned up
   435→				continue
   436→			}
   437→			subagentUsage.InputTokens += agentUsage.InputTokens
   438→			subagentUsage.CacheCreationTokens += agentUsage.CacheCreationTokens
   439→			subagentUsage.CacheReadTokens += agentUsage.CacheReadTokens
   440→			subagentUsage.OutputTokens += agentUsage.OutputTokens
   441→			subagentUsage.APICallCount += agentUsage.APICallCount
   442→		}
   443→		if subagentUsage.APICallCount > 0 {
   444→			mainUsage.SubagentTokens = subagentUsage
   445→		}
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	return mainUsage, nil
   449→}

     1→package geminicli

     9→// Transcript parsing types - Gemini CLI uses JSON format for session storage
    10→// Based on transcript_path format: ~/.gemini/tmp/<hash>/chats/session-<date>-<id>.json
    11→
    12→// Message type constants for Gemini transcripts
    13→const (
    14→	MessageTypeUser   = "user"
    15→	MessageTypeGemini = "gemini"
    16→)
    17→
    18→// GeminiTranscript represents the top-level structure of a Gemini session file
    19→type GeminiTranscript struct {
    20→	Messages []GeminiMessage `json:"messages"`
    21→}
    22→
    23→// GeminiMessage represents a single message in the transcript
    24→type GeminiMessage struct {
    25→	Type      string           `json:"type"` // MessageTypeUser or MessageTypeGemini
    26→	Content   string           `json:"content,omitempty"`
    27→	ToolCalls []GeminiToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
    28→}
    29→
    30→// GeminiToolCall represents a tool call in a gemini message
    31→type GeminiToolCall struct {
    32→	ID     string                 `json:"id"`
    33→	Name   string                 `json:"name"`
    34→	Args   map[string]interface{} `json:"args"`
    35→	Status string                 `json:"status,omitempty"`
    36→}
    37→
    38→// ParseTranscript parses raw JSON content into a transcript structure
    39→func ParseTranscript(data []byte) (*GeminiTranscript, error) {
    40→	var transcript GeminiTranscript
    41→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &transcript); err != nil {
    42→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
    43→	}
    44→	return &transcript, nil
    45→}
    46→
    47→// ExtractModifiedFiles extracts files modified by tool calls from transcript data
    48→func ExtractModifiedFiles(data []byte) ([]string, error) {
    49→	transcript, err := ParseTranscript(data)
    50→	if err != nil {
    51→		return nil, err
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	return ExtractModifiedFilesFromTranscript(transcript), nil
    55→}
    56→
    57→// ExtractModifiedFilesFromTranscript extracts files from a parsed transcript
    58→func ExtractModifiedFilesFromTranscript(transcript *GeminiTranscript) []string {
    59→	fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
    60→	var files []string
    61→
    62→	for _, msg := range transcript.Messages {
    63→		// Only process gemini messages (assistant messages)
    64→		if msg.Type != MessageTypeGemini {
    65→			continue
    66→		}
    67→
    68→		// Process tool calls in this message
    69→		for _, toolCall := range msg.ToolCalls {
    70→			// Check if it's a file modification tool
    71→			isModifyTool := false
    72→			for _, name := range FileModificationTools {
    73→				if toolCall.Name == name {
    74→					isModifyTool = true
    75→					break
    76→				}
    77→			}
    78→
    79→			if !isModifyTool {
    80→				continue
    81→			}
    82→
    83→			// Extract file path from args map
    84→			var file string
    85→			if fp, ok := toolCall.Args["file_path"].(string); ok && fp != "" {
    86→				file = fp
    87→			} else if p, ok := toolCall.Args["path"].(string); ok && p != "" {
    88→				file = p
    89→			} else if fn, ok := toolCall.Args["filename"].(string); ok && fn != "" {
    90→				file = fn
    91→			}
    92→
    93→			if file != "" && !fileSet[file] {
    94→				fileSet[file] = true
    95→				files = append(files, file)
    96→			}
    97→		}
    98→	}
    99→
   100→	return files
   101→}

   103→// ExtractLastUserPrompt extracts the last user message from transcript data
   104→func ExtractLastUserPrompt(data []byte) (string, error) {
   105→	transcript, err := ParseTranscript(data)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return "", err
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	return ExtractLastUserPromptFromTranscript(transcript), nil
   111→}
   112→
   113→// ExtractLastUserPromptFromTranscript extracts the last user prompt from a parsed transcript
   114→func ExtractLastUserPromptFromTranscript(transcript *GeminiTranscript) string {
   115→	for i := len(transcript.Messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   116→		msg := transcript.Messages[i]
   117→		if msg.Type != MessageTypeUser {
   118→			continue
   119→		}
   120→
   121→		// Content is now a string field
   122→		if msg.Content != "" {
   123→			return msg.Content
   124→		}
   125→	}
   126→	return ""
   127→}
   128→
   129→// ExtractAllUserPrompts extracts all user messages from transcript data
   130→func ExtractAllUserPrompts(data []byte) ([]string, error) {

   133→		return nil, err
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	return ExtractAllUserPromptsFromTranscript(transcript), nil
   137→}

   160→// ExtractLastAssistantMessageFromTranscript extracts the last gemini response from a parsed transcript
   161→func ExtractLastAssistantMessageFromTranscript(transcript *GeminiTranscript) string {
   162→	for i := len(transcript.Messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   163→		msg := transcript.Messages[i]

   171→// TokenUsage represents aggregated token usage for a checkpoint
   172→type TokenUsage struct {
   173→	// InputTokens is the number of input tokens (fresh, not from cache)
   174→	InputTokens int `json:"input_tokens"`
   175→	// OutputTokens is the number of output tokens generated
   176→	OutputTokens int `json:"output_tokens"`
   177→	// CacheReadTokens is the number of tokens read from cache
   178→	CacheReadTokens int `json:"cache_read_tokens"`
   179→	// APICallCount is the number of API calls made
   180→	APICallCount int `json:"api_call_count"`
   181→}
   182→
   183→// CalculateTokenUsage calculates token usage from a Gemini transcript.
   184→// This is specific to Gemini's API format where each message may have a tokens object
   185→// with input, output, cached, thoughts, tool, and total counts.
   186→// Only processes messages from startMessageIndex onwards (0-indexed).
   187→func CalculateTokenUsage(data []byte, startMessageIndex int) *TokenUsage {
   188→	var transcript struct {
   189→		Messages []geminiMessageWithTokens `json:"messages"`
   190→	}
   191→
   192→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &transcript); err != nil {
   193→		return &TokenUsage{}
   194→	}
   195→
   196→	usage := &TokenUsage{}
   197→
   198→	for i, msg := range transcript.Messages {
   199→		// Skip messages before startMessageIndex
   200→		if i < startMessageIndex {
   201→			continue
   202→		}
   203→
   204→		// Only count tokens from gemini (assistant) messages
   205→		if msg.Type != MessageTypeGemini {
   206→			continue
   207→		}
   208→
   209→		if msg.Tokens == nil {
   210→			continue
   211→		}
   212→
   213→		usage.APICallCount++
   214→		usage.InputTokens += msg.Tokens.Input
   215→		usage.OutputTokens += msg.Tokens.Output
   216→		usage.CacheReadTokens += msg.Tokens.Cached
   217→	}
   218→
   219→	return usage
   220→}
   221→
   222→// CalculateTokenUsageFromFile calculates token usage from a Gemini transcript file.
   223→// If startMessageIndex > 0, only considers messages from that index onwards.
   224→func CalculateTokenUsageFromFile(path string, startMessageIndex int) (*TokenUsage, error) {
   225→	if path == "" {
   226→		return &TokenUsage{}, nil
   227→	}
   228→
   229→	data, err := os.ReadFile(path) //nolint:gosec // Reading from controlled transcript path
   230→	if err != nil {
   231→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   232→			return &TokenUsage{}, nil
   233→		}
   234→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	return CalculateTokenUsage(data, startMessageIndex), nil
   238→}

    26→// WriteCommitted writes a committed checkpoint to the entire/sessions branch.
    27→// Checkpoints are stored at sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    28→//
    29→// For task checkpoints (IsTask=true), additional files are written under tasks/<tool-use-id>/:
    30→//   - For incremental checkpoints: checkpoints/NNN-<tool-use-id>.json
    31→//   - For final checkpoints: checkpoint.json and agent-<agent-id>.jsonl
    32→func (s *GitStore) WriteCommitted(ctx context.Context, opts WriteCommittedOptions) error {
    33→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
    34→
    35→	// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
    36→	if err := id.Validate(opts.CheckpointID); err != nil {
    37→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    38→	}
    39→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    40→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    41→	}
    42→	if err := paths.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
    43→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    44→	}
    45→	if err := paths.ValidateAgentID(opts.AgentID); err != nil {
    46→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid checkpoint options: %w", err)
    47→	}
    48→
    49→	// Ensure sessions branch exists
    50→	if err := s.ensureSessionsBranch(); err != nil {
    51→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to ensure sessions branch: %w", err)
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	// Get current branch tip and flatten tree
    55→	ref, entries, err := s.getSessionsBranchEntries()
    56→	if err != nil {
    57→		return err
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	// Use sharded path: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/
    61→	basePath := paths.CheckpointPath(opts.CheckpointID) + "/"
    62→
    63→	// Track task metadata path for commit trailer
    64→	var taskMetadataPath string
    65→
    66→	// Handle task checkpoints
    67→	if opts.IsTask && opts.ToolUseID != "" {
    68→		taskMetadataPath, err = s.writeTaskCheckpointEntries(opts, basePath, entries)
    69→		if err != nil {
    70→			return err
    71→		}
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Write standard checkpoint entries (transcript, prompts, context, metadata)
    75→	if err := s.writeStandardCheckpointEntries(opts, basePath, entries); err != nil {
    76→		return err
    77→	}
    78→
    79→	// Build and commit
    80→	newTreeHash, err := BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
    81→	if err != nil {
    82→		return err
    83→	}
    84→
    85→	commitMsg := s.buildCommitMessage(opts, taskMetadataPath)
    86→	newCommitHash, err := s.createCommit(newTreeHash, ref.Hash(), commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
    87→	if err != nil {
    88→		return err
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
    92→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, newCommitHash)
    93→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
    94→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)
    95→	}
    96→
    97→	return nil
    98→}
    99→
   100→// getSessionsBranchEntries returns the sessions branch reference and flattened tree entries.
   101→func (s *GitStore) getSessionsBranchEntries() (*plumbing.Reference, map[string]object.TreeEntry, error) {
   102→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   103→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   104→	if err != nil {
   105→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get sessions branch reference: %w", err)
   106→	}
   107→
   108→	parentCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   109→	if err != nil {
   110→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   111→	}
   112→
   113→	baseTree, err := parentCommit.Tree()
   114→	if err != nil {
   115→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   116→	}
   117→
   118→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   119→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   120→		return nil, nil, err
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	return ref, entries, nil
   124→}
   125→
   126→// writeTaskCheckpointEntries writes task-specific checkpoint entries and returns the task metadata path.
   127→func (s *GitStore) writeTaskCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   128→	taskPath := basePath + "tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID + "/"
   129→
   130→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   131→		return s.writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   132→	}
   133→	return s.writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts, taskPath, entries)
   134→}
   135→
   136→// writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint writes an incremental checkpoint file during task execution.
   137→func (s *GitStore) writeIncrementalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   138→	checkpoint := incrementalCheckpointData{
   139→		Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   140→		ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   141→		Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   142→		Data:      opts.IncrementalData,
   143→	}
   144→	cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   145→	if err != nil {
   146→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   147→	}
   148→	cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   149→	if err != nil {
   150→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   151→	}
   152→
   153→	cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   154→	cpPath := taskPath + "checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   155→	entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   156→		Name: cpPath,
   157→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   158→		Hash: cpBlobHash,
   159→	}
   160→	return cpPath, nil
   161→}
   162→
   163→// writeFinalTaskCheckpoint writes the final checkpoint.json and subagent transcript.
   164→func (s *GitStore) writeFinalTaskCheckpoint(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskPath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) (string, error) {
   165→	checkpoint := taskCheckpointData{
   166→		SessionID:      opts.SessionID,
   167→		ToolUseID:      opts.ToolUseID,
   168→		CheckpointUUID: opts.CheckpointUUID,
   169→		AgentID:        opts.AgentID,
   170→	}
   171→	checkpointData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(checkpoint, "", "  ")
   172→	if err != nil {
   173→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal task checkpoint: %w", err)
   174→	}
   175→	blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, checkpointData)
   176→	if err != nil {
   177→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create task checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	checkpointFile := taskPath + "checkpoint.json"
   181→	entries[checkpointFile] = object.TreeEntry{
   182→		Name: checkpointFile,
   183→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   184→		Hash: blobHash,
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// Write subagent transcript if available
   188→	if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   189→		agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath)
   190→		if readErr == nil {
   191→			agentBlobHash, agentBlobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent)
   192→			if agentBlobErr == nil {
   193→				agentPath := taskPath + "agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   194→				entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   195→					Name: agentPath,
   196→					Mode: filemode.Regular,
   197→					Hash: agentBlobHash,
   198→				}
   199→			}
   200→		}
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Return task path without trailing slash
   204→	return taskPath[:len(taskPath)-1], nil
   205→}
   206→
   207→// writeStandardCheckpointEntries writes transcript, prompts, context, metadata.json and any additional files.
   208→// If the checkpoint already exists (from a previous session), archives the existing files to a numbered subfolder.
   209→func (s *GitStore) writeStandardCheckpointEntries(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   210→	// Check if checkpoint already exists (multi-session support)
   211→	var existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata
   212→	metadataPath := basePath + paths.MetadataFileName
   213→	if entry, exists := entries[metadataPath]; exists {
   214→		// Read existing metadata to get session count
   215→		existing, err := s.readMetadataFromBlob(entry.Hash)
   216→		if err == nil {
   217→			existingMetadata = existing
   218→			// Archive existing session files to numbered subfolder
   219→			s.archiveExistingSession(basePath, existingMetadata, entries)
   220→		}
   221→	}
   222→
   223→	// Write transcript (from in-memory content or file path)
   224→	if err := s.writeTranscript(opts, basePath, entries); err != nil {
   225→		return err
   226→	}
   227→
   228→	// Write prompts
   229→	if len(opts.Prompts) > 0 {
   230→		promptContent := strings.Join(opts.Prompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   231→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(promptContent))
   232→		if err != nil {
   233→			return err
   234→		}
   235→		entries[basePath+paths.PromptFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   236→			Name: basePath + paths.PromptFileName,
   237→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   238→			Hash: blobHash,
   239→		}
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// Write context
   243→	if len(opts.Context) > 0 {
   244→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, opts.Context)
   245→		if err != nil {
   246→			return err
   247→		}
   248→		entries[basePath+paths.ContextFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   249→			Name: basePath + paths.ContextFileName,
   250→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   251→			Hash: blobHash,
   252→		}
   253→	}
   254→
   255→	// Copy additional metadata files from directory if specified
   256→	if opts.MetadataDir != "" {
   257→		if err := s.copyMetadataDir(opts.MetadataDir, basePath, entries); err != nil {
   258→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy metadata directory: %w", err)
   259→		}
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	// Write metadata.json (with merged info if existing metadata present)
   263→	return s.writeMetadataJSON(opts, basePath, entries, existingMetadata)
   264→}
   265→
   266→// writeTranscript writes the transcript file from in-memory content or file path.
   267→// If the transcript exceeds MaxChunkSize, it's split into multiple chunk files.
   268→func (s *GitStore) writeTranscript(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   269→	transcript := opts.Transcript
   270→	if len(transcript) == 0 && opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   271→		var readErr error
   272→		transcript, readErr = os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath)
   273→		if readErr != nil {
   274→			// Non-fatal: transcript may not exist yet
   275→			transcript = nil
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→	if len(transcript) == 0 {
   279→		return nil
   280→	}
   281→
   282→	// Chunk the transcript if it's too large
   283→	chunks, err := ChunkTranscript(transcript, opts.Agent)
   284→	if err != nil {
   285→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to chunk transcript: %w", err)
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	// Write chunk files
   289→	for i, chunk := range chunks {
   290→		chunkPath := basePath + ChunkFileName(paths.TranscriptFileName, i)
   291→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, chunk)
   292→		if err != nil {
   293→			return err
   294→		}
   295→		entries[chunkPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   296→			Name: chunkPath,
   297→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   298→			Hash: blobHash,
   299→		}
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// Content hash for deduplication (hash of full transcript)
   303→	contentHash := fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256(transcript))
   304→	hashBlob, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(contentHash))
   305→	if err != nil {
   306→		return err
   307→	}
   308→	entries[basePath+paths.ContentHashFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   309→		Name: basePath + paths.ContentHashFileName,
   310→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   311→		Hash: hashBlob,
   312→	}
   313→	return nil
   314→}
   315→
   316→// writeMetadataJSON writes the metadata.json file for the checkpoint.
   317→// If existingMetadata is provided, merges session info from the previous session(s).
   318→func (s *GitStore) writeMetadataJSON(opts WriteCommittedOptions, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry, existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata) error {
   319→	metadata := CommittedMetadata{
   320→		CheckpointID:           opts.CheckpointID,
   321→		SessionID:              opts.SessionID,
   322→		Strategy:               opts.Strategy,
   323→		CreatedAt:              time.Now(),
   324→		Branch:                 opts.Branch,
   325→		CheckpointsCount:       opts.CheckpointsCount,
   326→		FilesTouched:           opts.FilesTouched,
   327→		Agent:                  opts.Agent,
   328→		IsTask:                 opts.IsTask,
   329→		ToolUseID:              opts.ToolUseID,
   330→		SessionCount:           1,
   331→		SessionIDs:             []string{opts.SessionID},
   332→		TranscriptUUIDAtStart:  opts.TranscriptUUIDAtStart,
   333→		TranscriptLinesAtStart: opts.TranscriptLinesAtStart,
   334→		TokenUsage:             opts.TokenUsage,
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	// Merge with existing metadata if present (multi-session checkpoint)
   338→	if existingMetadata != nil {
   339→		// Get existing session count (default to 1 for backwards compat)
   340→		existingCount := existingMetadata.SessionCount
   341→		if existingCount == 0 {
   342→			existingCount = 1
   343→		}
   344→		metadata.SessionCount = existingCount + 1
   345→
   346→		// Merge session IDs
   347→		existingIDs := existingMetadata.SessionIDs
   348→		if len(existingIDs) == 0 {
   349→			// Backwards compat: old metadata only had SessionID
   350→			existingIDs = []string{existingMetadata.SessionID}
   351→		}
   352→		metadata.SessionIDs = append(metadata.SessionIDs[:0], existingIDs...)
   353→		metadata.SessionIDs = append(metadata.SessionIDs, opts.SessionID)
   354→
   355→		// Merge files touched (deduplicated)
   356→		metadata.FilesTouched = mergeFilesTouched(existingMetadata.FilesTouched, opts.FilesTouched)
   357→
   358→		// Sum checkpoint counts
   359→		metadata.CheckpointsCount = existingMetadata.CheckpointsCount + opts.CheckpointsCount
   360→	}
   361→
   362→	metadataJSON, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(metadata, "", "  ")
   363→	if err != nil {
   364→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal metadata: %w", err)
   365→	}
   366→	metadataHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, metadataJSON)
   367→	if err != nil {
   368→		return err
   369→	}
   370→	entries[basePath+paths.MetadataFileName] = object.TreeEntry{
   371→		Name: basePath + paths.MetadataFileName,
   372→		Mode: filemode.Regular,
   373→		Hash: metadataHash,
   374→	}
   375→	return nil
   376→}
   377→
   378→// mergeFilesTouched combines two file lists, removing duplicates.
   379→func mergeFilesTouched(existing, additional []string) []string {
   380→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   381→	var result []string
   382→
   383→	for _, f := range existing {
   384→		if !seen[f] {
   385→			seen[f] = true
   386→			result = append(result, f)
   387→		}
   388→	}
   389→	for _, f := range additional {
   390→		if !seen[f] {
   391→			seen[f] = true
   392→			result = append(result, f)
   393→		}
   394→	}
   395→
   396→	sort.Strings(result)
   397→	return result
   398→}
   399→
   400→// readMetadataFromBlob reads CommittedMetadata from a blob hash.
   401→func (s *GitStore) readMetadataFromBlob(hash plumbing.Hash) (*CommittedMetadata, error) {
   402→	blob, err := s.repo.BlobObject(hash)
   403→	if err != nil {
   404→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob: %w", err)
   405→	}
   406→
   407→	reader, err := blob.Reader()
   408→	if err != nil {
   409→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get blob reader: %w", err)
   410→	}
   411→	defer reader.Close()
   412→
   413→	var metadata CommittedMetadata
   414→	if err := json.NewDecoder(reader).Decode(&metadata); err != nil {
   415→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode metadata: %w", err)
   416→	}
   417→
   418→	return &metadata, nil
   419→}
   420→
   421→// archiveExistingSession moves existing session files to a numbered subfolder.
   422→// The subfolder number is based on the current session count (so first archived session goes to "1/").
   423→func (s *GitStore) archiveExistingSession(basePath string, existingMetadata *CommittedMetadata, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) {
   424→	// Determine archive folder number
   425→	sessionCount := existingMetadata.SessionCount
   426→	if sessionCount == 0 {
   427→		sessionCount = 1 // backwards compat
   428→	}
   429→	archivePath := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d/", basePath, sessionCount)
   430→
   431→	// Files to archive (standard checkpoint files at basePath, excluding tasks/ subfolder)
   432→	filesToArchive := []string{
   433→		paths.MetadataFileName,
   434→		paths.TranscriptFileName,
   435→		paths.PromptFileName,
   436→		paths.ContextFileName,
   437→		paths.ContentHashFileName,
   438→	}
   439→
   440→	// Move each file to archive folder
   441→	for _, filename := range filesToArchive {
   442→		srcPath := basePath + filename
   443→		if entry, exists := entries[srcPath]; exists {
   444→			// Add to archive location
   445→			dstPath := archivePath + filename
   446→			entries[dstPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   447→				Name: dstPath,
   448→				Mode: entry.Mode,
   449→				Hash: entry.Hash,
   450→			}
   451→			// Remove from original location (will be overwritten by new session)
   452→			delete(entries, srcPath)
   453→		}
   454→	}
   455→}
   456→
   457→// readArchivedSessions reads transcript data from archived session subfolders (1/, 2/, etc.).
   458→// Returns sessions ordered by folder index (oldest first).
   459→func (s *GitStore) readArchivedSessions(checkpointTree *object.Tree, sessionCount int, agentType string) []ArchivedSession {
   460→	var archived []ArchivedSession
   461→
   462→	// Archived sessions are in numbered folders: 1/, 2/, etc.
   463→	// The most recent session is at the root level (not archived).
   464→	// Session count N means there are N-1 archived sessions.
   465→	for i := 1; i < sessionCount; i++ {
   466→		folderName := strconv.Itoa(i)
   467→
   468→		// Try to get the archived session subtree
   469→		subTree, err := checkpointTree.Tree(folderName)
   470→		if err != nil {
   471→			continue // Folder doesn't exist, skip
   472→		}
   473→
   474→		session := ArchivedSession{
   475→			FolderIndex: i,
   476→		}
   477→
   478→		// Read metadata to get session ID
   479→		if metadataFile, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   480→			if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   481→				var metadata CommittedMetadata
   482→				if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &metadata); jsonErr == nil {
   483→					session.SessionID = metadata.SessionID
   484→				}
   485→			}
   486→		}
   487→
   488→		// Read transcript (handles both chunked and non-chunked formats)
   489→		if transcript, err := readTranscriptFromTree(subTree, agentType); err == nil && transcript != nil {
   490→			session.Transcript = transcript
   491→		}
   492→
   493→		// Read prompts
   494→		if file, fileErr := subTree.File(paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   495→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   496→				session.Prompts = content
   497→			}
   498→		}
   499→
   500→		// Only add if we got a transcript
   501→		if len(session.Transcript) > 0 {
   502→			archived = append(archived, session)
   503→		}
   504→	}
   505→
   506→	return archived
   507→}
   508→
   509→// buildCommitMessage constructs the commit message with proper trailers.
   510→// The commit subject is always "Checkpoint: <id>" for consistency.
   511→// If CommitSubject is provided (e.g., for task checkpoints), it's included in the body.
   512→func (s *GitStore) buildCommitMessage(opts WriteCommittedOptions, taskMetadataPath string) string {
   513→	var commitMsg strings.Builder
   514→
   515→	// Subject line is always the checkpoint ID for consistent formatting
   516→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Checkpoint: %s\n\n", opts.CheckpointID))
   517→
   518→	// Include custom description in body if provided (e.g., task checkpoint details)
   519→	if opts.CommitSubject != "" {
   520→		commitMsg.WriteString(opts.CommitSubject + "\n\n")
   521→	}
   522→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.SessionTrailerKey, opts.SessionID))
   523→	commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.StrategyTrailerKey, opts.Strategy))
   524→	if opts.Agent != "" {
   525→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.AgentTrailerKey, opts.Agent))
   526→	}
   527→	if opts.EphemeralBranch != "" {
   528→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.EphemeralBranchTrailerKey, opts.EphemeralBranch))
   529→	}
   530→	if taskMetadataPath != "" {
   531→		commitMsg.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", trailers.MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataPath))
   532→	}
   533→
   534→	return commitMsg.String()
   535→}
   536→
   537→// incrementalCheckpointData represents an incremental checkpoint during subagent execution.
   538→// This mirrors strategy.SubagentCheckpoint but avoids import cycles.
   539→type incrementalCheckpointData struct {
   540→	Type      string          `json:"type"`
   541→	ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   542→	Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   543→	Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   544→}
   545→
   546→// taskCheckpointData represents a final task checkpoint.
   547→// This mirrors strategy.TaskCheckpoint but avoids import cycles.
   548→type taskCheckpointData struct {
   549→	SessionID      string `json:"session_id"`
   550→	ToolUseID      string `json:"tool_use_id"`
   551→	CheckpointUUID string `json:"checkpoint_uuid"`
   552→	AgentID        string `json:"agent_id,omitempty"`
   553→}
   554→
   555→// ReadCommitted reads a committed checkpoint by ID from the entire/sessions branch.
   556→// Returns nil, nil if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   557→//
   558→
   559→func (s *GitStore) ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) (*ReadCommittedResult, error) {
   560→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   561→
   562→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   563→	if err != nil {
   564→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // No sessions branch means no checkpoint exists
   565→	}
   566→
   567→	checkpointPath := paths.CheckpointPath(checkpointID)
   568→	checkpointTree, err := tree.Tree(checkpointPath)
   569→	if err != nil {
   570→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Checkpoint directory not found
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	result := &ReadCommittedResult{}
   574→
   575→	// Read metadata.json
   576→	if metadataFile, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   577→		if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   578→			//nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort parsing, defaults are fine
   579→			json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &result.Metadata)
   580→			result.Metadata.Strategy = trailers.NormalizeStrategyName(result.Metadata.Strategy)
   581→		}
   582→	}
   583→
   584→	// Read transcript (handles both chunked and non-chunked formats)
   585→	if transcript, err := readTranscriptFromTree(checkpointTree, result.Metadata.Agent); err == nil && transcript != nil {
   586→		result.Transcript = transcript
   587→	}
   588→
   589→	// Read prompts
   590→	if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   591→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   592→			result.Prompts = content
   593→		}
   594→	}
   595→
   596→	// Read context
   597→	if file, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.ContextFileName); fileErr == nil {
   598→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   599→			result.Context = content
   600→		}
   601→	}
   602→
   603→	// Read archived sessions if this is a multi-session checkpoint
   604→	if result.Metadata.SessionCount > 1 {
   605→		result.ArchivedSessions = s.readArchivedSessions(checkpointTree, result.Metadata.SessionCount, result.Metadata.Agent)
   606→	}
   607→
   608→	return result, nil
   609→}
   610→
   611→// ListCommitted lists all committed checkpoints from the entire/sessions branch.
   612→// Scans sharded paths: <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/ directories containing metadata.json.
   613→//
   614→
   615→func (s *GitStore) ListCommitted(ctx context.Context) ([]CommittedInfo, error) {
   616→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   617→
   618→	tree, err := s.getSessionsBranchTree()
   619→	if err != nil {
   620→		return []CommittedInfo{}, nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions branch means empty list
   621→	}
   622→
   623→	var checkpoints []CommittedInfo
   624→
   625→	// Scan sharded structure: <2-char-prefix>/<remaining-id>/metadata.json
   626→	for _, bucketEntry := range tree.Entries {
   627→		if bucketEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   628→			continue
   629→		}
   630→		// Bucket should be 2 hex chars
   631→		if len(bucketEntry.Name) != 2 {
   632→			continue
   633→		}
   634→
   635→		bucketTree, treeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(bucketEntry.Hash)
   636→		if treeErr != nil {
   637→			continue
   638→		}
   639→
   640→		// Each entry in the bucket is the remaining part of the checkpoint ID
   641→		for _, checkpointEntry := range bucketTree.Entries {
   642→			if checkpointEntry.Mode != filemode.Dir {
   643→				continue
   644→			}
   645→
   646→			checkpointTree, cpTreeErr := s.repo.TreeObject(checkpointEntry.Hash)
   647→			if cpTreeErr != nil {
   648→				continue
   649→			}
   650→
   651→			// Reconstruct checkpoint ID: <bucket><remaining>
   652→			checkpointID := bucketEntry.Name + checkpointEntry.Name
   653→
   654→			info := CommittedInfo{
   655→				CheckpointID: checkpointID,
   656→			}
   657→
   658→			// Get details from metadata file
   659→			if metadataFile, fileErr := checkpointTree.File(paths.MetadataFileName); fileErr == nil {
   660→				if content, contentErr := metadataFile.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   661→					var metadata CommittedMetadata
   662→					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &metadata); err == nil {
   663→						info.SessionID = metadata.SessionID
   664→						info.CreatedAt = metadata.CreatedAt
   665→						info.CheckpointsCount = metadata.CheckpointsCount
   666→						info.FilesTouched = metadata.FilesTouched
   667→						info.Agent = metadata.Agent
   668→						info.IsTask = metadata.IsTask
   669→						info.ToolUseID = metadata.ToolUseID
   670→						info.SessionCount = metadata.SessionCount
   671→						info.SessionIDs = metadata.SessionIDs
   672→					}
   673→				}
   674→			}
   675→
   676→			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, info)
   677→		}
   678→	}
   679→
   680→	// Sort by time (most recent first)
   681→	sort.Slice(checkpoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   682→		return checkpoints[i].CreatedAt.After(checkpoints[j].CreatedAt)
   683→	})
   684→
   685→	return checkpoints, nil
   686→}

   688→// GetTranscript retrieves the transcript for a specific checkpoint ID.
   689→func (s *GitStore) GetTranscript(ctx context.Context, checkpointID string) ([]byte, error) {
   690→	result, err := s.ReadCommitted(ctx, checkpointID)
   691→	if err != nil {
   692→		return nil, err
   693→	}
   694→	if result == nil {
   695→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointID)
   696→	}
   697→	if len(result.Transcript) == 0 {
   698→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no transcript found for checkpoint: %s", checkpointID)
   699→	}
   700→	return result.Transcript, nil
   701→}

   703→// GetSessionLog retrieves the session transcript and session ID for a checkpoint.
   704→// This is the primary method for looking up session logs by checkpoint ID.
   705→// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   706→// Returns ErrNoTranscript if the checkpoint exists but has no transcript.
   707→func (s *GitStore) GetSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error) {
   708→	result, err := s.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), cpID.String())
   709→	if err != nil {
   710→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   711→	}
   712→	if result == nil {
   713→		return nil, "", ErrCheckpointNotFound
   714→	}
   715→	if len(result.Transcript) == 0 {
   716→		return nil, "", ErrNoTranscript
   717→	}
   718→	return result.Transcript, result.Metadata.SessionID, nil
   719→}

   721→// LookupSessionLog is a convenience function that opens the repository and retrieves
   722→// a session log by checkpoint ID. This is the primary entry point for callers that
   723→// don't already have a GitStore instance.
   724→// Returns ErrCheckpointNotFound if the checkpoint doesn't exist.
   725→// Returns ErrNoTranscript if the checkpoint exists but has no transcript.
   726→func LookupSessionLog(cpID id.CheckpointID) ([]byte, string, error) {
   727→	repo, err := git.PlainOpenWithOptions(".", &git.PlainOpenOptions{DetectDotGit: true})
   728→	if err != nil {
   729→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   730→	}
   731→	store := NewGitStore(repo)
   732→	return store.GetSessionLog(cpID)
   733→}

   735→// ensureSessionsBranch ensures the entire/sessions branch exists.
   736→func (s *GitStore) ensureSessionsBranch() error {
   737→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   738→	_, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   739→	if err == nil {
   740→		return nil // Branch exists
   741→	}
   742→
   743→	// Create orphan branch with empty tree
   744→	emptyTreeHash, err := BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, make(map[string]object.TreeEntry))
   745→	if err != nil {
   746→		return err
   747→	}
   748→
   749→	authorName, authorEmail := getGitAuthorFromRepo(s.repo)
   750→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(emptyTreeHash, plumbing.ZeroHash, "Initialize sessions branch", authorName, authorEmail)
   751→	if err != nil {
   752→		return err
   753→	}
   754→
   755→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   756→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
   757→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to set branch reference: %w", err)
   758→	}
   759→	return nil
   760→}

   762→// getSessionsBranchTree returns the tree object for the entire/sessions branch.
   763→func (s *GitStore) getSessionsBranchTree() (*object.Tree, error) {
   764→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
   765→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   766→	if err != nil {
   767→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions branch not found: %w", err)
   768→	}
   769→
   770→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   771→	if err != nil {
   772→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   773→	}
   774→
   775→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   776→	if err != nil {
   777→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   778→	}
   779→
   780→	return tree, nil
   781→}

   783→// CreateBlobFromContent creates a blob object from in-memory content.
   784→// Exported for use by strategy package (session_test.go)
   785→func CreateBlobFromContent(repo *git.Repository, content []byte) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   786→	obj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   787→	obj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
   788→	obj.SetSize(int64(len(content)))
   789→
   790→	writer, err := obj.Writer()
   791→	if err != nil {
   792→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get object writer: %w", err)
   793→	}
   794→
   795→	_, err = writer.Write(content)
   796→	if err != nil {
   797→		_ = writer.Close()
   798→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content: %w", err)
   799→	}
   800→	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
   801→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to close blob writer: %w", err)
   802→	}
   803→
   804→	hash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(obj)
   805→	if err != nil {
   806→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob object: %w", err)
   807→	}
   808→	return hash, nil
   809→}

   811→// copyMetadataDir copies all files from a directory to the checkpoint path.
   812→// Used to include additional metadata files like task checkpoints, subagent transcripts, etc.
   813→func (s *GitStore) copyMetadataDir(metadataDir, basePath string, entries map[string]object.TreeEntry) error {
   814→	err := filepath.Walk(metadataDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
   815→		if err != nil {
   816→			return err
   817→		}
   818→		if info.IsDir() {
   819→			return nil
   820→		}
   821→
   822→		// Skip symlinks to prevent reading files outside the metadata directory.
   823→		// A symlink could point to sensitive files (e.g., /etc/passwd) which would
   824→		// then be captured in the checkpoint and stored in git history.
   825→		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   826→			return nil
   827→		}
   828→
   829→		// Get relative path within metadata dir
   830→		relPath, err := filepath.Rel(metadataDir, path)
   831→		if err != nil {
   832→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get relative path for %s: %w", path, err)
   833→		}
   834→
   835→		// Prevent path traversal via symlinks pointing outside the metadata dir
   836→		if strings.HasPrefix(relPath, "..") {
   837→			return fmt.Errorf("path traversal detected: %s", relPath)
   838→		}
   839→
   840→		// Create blob from file
   841→		blobHash, mode, err := createBlobFromFile(s.repo, path)
   842→		if err != nil {
   843→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob for %s: %w", path, err)
   844→		}
   845→
   846→		// Store at checkpoint path
   847→		fullPath := basePath + relPath
   848→		entries[fullPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   849→			Name: fullPath,
   850→			Mode: mode,
   851→			Hash: blobHash,
   852→		}
   853→
   854→		return nil
   855→	})
   856→	if err != nil {
   857→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to walk metadata directory: %w", err)
   858→	}
   859→	return nil
   860→}

   862→// getGitAuthorFromRepo retrieves the git user.name and user.email from the repository config.
   863→func getGitAuthorFromRepo(repo *git.Repository) (name, email string) {
   864→	// Get repository config (includes local settings)
   865→	cfg, err := repo.Config()
   866→	if err == nil {
   867→		name = cfg.User.Name
   868→		email = cfg.User.Email
   869→	}
   870→
   871→	// Provide sensible defaults if git user is not configured
   872→	if name == "" {
   873→		name = "Unknown"
   874→	}
   875→	if email == "" {
   876→		email = "unknown@local"
   877→	}
   878→
   879→	return name, email
   880→}

   882→// readTranscriptFromTree reads a transcript from a git tree, handling both chunked and non-chunked formats.
   883→// It checks for chunk files first (.001, .002, etc.), then falls back to the base file.
   884→// The agentType is used for reassembling chunks in the correct format.
   885→func readTranscriptFromTree(tree *object.Tree, agentType string) ([]byte, error) {
   886→	// Collect all transcript-related files
   887→	var chunkFiles []string
   888→	var hasBaseFile bool
   889→
   890→	for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
   891→		if entry.Name == paths.TranscriptFileName || entry.Name == paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy {
   892→			hasBaseFile = true
   893→		}
   894→		// Check for chunk files (full.jsonl.001, full.jsonl.002, etc.)
   895→		if strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name, paths.TranscriptFileName+".") {
   896→			idx := ParseChunkIndex(entry.Name, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   897→			if idx > 0 {
   898→				chunkFiles = append(chunkFiles, entry.Name)
   899→			}
   900→		}
   901→	}
   902→
   903→	// If we have chunk files, read and reassemble them
   904→	if len(chunkFiles) > 0 {
   905→		// Sort chunk files by index
   906→		chunkFiles = SortChunkFiles(chunkFiles, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   907→
   908→		// Check if base file should be included as chunk 0
   909→		if hasBaseFile {
   910→			chunkFiles = append([]string{paths.TranscriptFileName}, chunkFiles...)
   911→		}
   912→
   913→		var chunks [][]byte
   914→		for _, chunkFile := range chunkFiles {
   915→			file, err := tree.File(chunkFile)
   916→			if err != nil {
   917→				continue
   918→			}
   919→			content, err := file.Contents()
   920→			if err != nil {
   921→				continue
   922→			}
   923→			chunks = append(chunks, []byte(content))
   924→		}
   925→
   926→		if len(chunks) > 0 {
   927→			return ReassembleTranscript(chunks, agentType)
   928→		}
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	// Fall back to reading base file (non-chunked or backwards compatibility)
   932→	if file, err := tree.File(paths.TranscriptFileName); err == nil {
   933→		if content, err := file.Contents(); err == nil {
   934→			return []byte(content), nil
   935→		}
   936→	}
   937→
   938→	// Try legacy filename
   939→	if file, err := tree.File(paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); err == nil {
   940→		if content, err := file.Contents(); err == nil {
   941→			return []byte(content), nil
   942→		}
   943→	}
   944→
   945→	return nil, nil
   946→}

    37→// WriteTemporary writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    38→// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    39→// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    40→// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    41→// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    42→func (s *GitStore) WriteTemporary(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryOptions) (WriteTemporaryResult, error) {
    43→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use (e.g., cancellation)
    44→
    45→	// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    46→	if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    47→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    48→	}
    49→
    50→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    51→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    52→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    53→	}
    54→
    55→	// Get shadow branch name
    56→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit)
    57→
    58→	// Get or create shadow branch
    59→	parentHash, baseTreeHash, err := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName)
    60→	if err != nil {
    61→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", err)
    62→	}
    63→
    64→	// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
    65→	var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
    66→	if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
    67→		if lastCommit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); err == nil {
    68→			lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
    69→		}
    70→	}
    71→
    72→	// Collect all files to include
    73→	var allFiles []string
    74→	if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    75→		// For the first checkpoint of this session, capture ALL files in working directory
    76→		// This ensures untracked files present at session start are included
    77→		allFiles, err = collectWorkingDirectoryFiles()
    78→		if err != nil {
    79→			return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect working directory files: %w", err)
    80→		}
    81→	} else {
    82→		// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files
    83→		allFiles = make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
    84→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
    85→		allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	// Build tree with changes
    89→	treeHash, err := s.buildTreeWithChanges(baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
    90→	if err != nil {
    91→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
    92→	}
    93→
    94→	// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the last checkpoint
    95→	if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
    96→		return WriteTemporaryResult{
    97→			CommitHash: parentHash,
    98→			Skipped:    true,
    99→		}, nil
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	// Create checkpoint commit with trailers
   103→	commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   104→
   105→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	// Update branch reference
   111→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   112→	newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   113→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
   114→		return WriteTemporaryResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to update branch reference: %w", err)
   115→	}
   116→
   117→	return WriteTemporaryResult{
   118→		CommitHash: commitHash,
   119→		Skipped:    false,
   120→	}, nil
   121→}

   123→// ReadTemporary reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
   124→// Returns nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
   125→func (s *GitStore) ReadTemporary(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string) (*ReadTemporaryResult, error) {
   126→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   127→
   128→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit)
   129→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   130→
   131→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Branch not found is an expected case
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   137→	if err != nil {
   138→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   139→	}
   140→
   141→	// Extract session ID and metadata dir from commit trailers
   142→	sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   143→	metadataDir, _ := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
   144→
   145→	return &ReadTemporaryResult{
   146→		CommitHash:  ref.Hash(),
   147→		TreeHash:    commit.TreeHash,
   148→		SessionID:   sessionID,
   149→		MetadataDir: metadataDir,
   150→		Timestamp:   commit.Author.When,
   151→	}, nil
   152→}

   154→// ListTemporary lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
   155→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporary(ctx context.Context) ([]TemporaryInfo, error) {
   156→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   157→
   158→	iter, err := s.repo.Branches()
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list branches: %w", err)
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	var results []TemporaryInfo
   164→	err = iter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   165→		branchName := ref.Name().Short()
   166→		if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {
   167→			return nil
   168→		}
   169→
   170→		// Skip the sessions branch
   171→		if branchName == paths.MetadataBranchName {
   172→			return nil
   173→		}
   174→
   175→		commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   176→		if commitErr != nil {
   177→			//nolint:nilerr // Skip branches we can't read (non-fatal)
   178→			return nil
   179→		}
   180→
   181→		sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   182→
   183→		// Extract base commit from branch name
   184→		baseCommit := strings.TrimPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix)
   185→
   186→		results = append(results, TemporaryInfo{
   187→			BranchName:   branchName,
   188→			BaseCommit:   baseCommit,
   189→			LatestCommit: ref.Hash(),
   190→			SessionID:    sessionID,
   191→			Timestamp:    commit.Author.When,
   192→		})
   193→
   194→		return nil
   195→	})
   196→
   197→	if err != nil {
   198→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate branches: %w", err)
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	return results, nil
   202→}

   204→// WriteTemporaryTask writes a task checkpoint to a shadow branch.
   205→// Task checkpoints include both code changes and task-specific metadata.
   206→// Returns the commit hash of the created checkpoint.
   207→func (s *GitStore) WriteTemporaryTask(ctx context.Context, opts WriteTemporaryTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   208→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   209→
   210→	// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
   211→	if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
   212→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for task checkpoint")
   213→	}
   214→
   215→	// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
   216→	if err := paths.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
   217→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   218→	}
   219→	if err := paths.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   220→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   221→	}
   222→	if err := paths.ValidateAgentID(opts.AgentID); err != nil {
   223→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   224→	}
   225→
   226→	// Get shadow branch name
   227→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit)
   228→
   229→	// Get or create shadow branch
   230→	parentHash, baseTreeHash, err := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName)
   231→	if err != nil {
   232→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", err)
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	// Collect all files to include in the commit
   236→	allFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
   237→	allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
   238→	allFiles = append(allFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
   239→
   240→	// Build new tree with code changes (no metadata dir yet)
   241→	newTreeHash, err := s.buildTreeWithChanges(baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, "", "")
   242→	if err != nil {
   243→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	// Add task metadata to tree
   247→	newTreeHash, err = s.addTaskMetadataToTree(newTreeHash, opts)
   248→	if err != nil {
   249→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to add task metadata: %w", err)
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	// Create the commit
   253→	commitHash, err := s.createCommit(newTreeHash, parentHash, opts.CommitMessage, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   254→	if err != nil {
   255→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	// Update shadow branch reference
   259→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   260→	ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitHash)
   261→	if err := s.repo.Storer.SetReference(ref); err != nil {
   262→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", err)
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	return commitHash, nil
   266→}
   267→
   268→// addTaskMetadataToTree adds task checkpoint metadata to a git tree.
   269→// When IsIncremental is true, only adds the incremental checkpoint file.
   270→func (s *GitStore) addTaskMetadataToTree(baseTreeHash plumbing.Hash, opts WriteTemporaryTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   271→	// Get base tree and flatten it
   272→	baseTree, err := s.repo.TreeObject(baseTreeHash)
   273→	if err != nil {
   274→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	entries := make(map[string]object.TreeEntry)
   278→	if err := FlattenTree(s.repo, baseTree, "", entries); err != nil {
   279→		return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to flatten tree: %w", err)
   280→	}
   281→
   282→	// Compute metadata paths
   283→	sessionMetadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + opts.SessionID
   284→	taskMetadataDir := sessionMetadataDir + "/tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID
   285→
   286→	if opts.IsIncremental {
   287→		// Incremental checkpoint: only add the checkpoint file
   288→		// Use proper JSON marshaling to handle nil/empty IncrementalData correctly
   289→		incrementalCheckpoint := struct {
   290→			Type      string          `json:"type"`
   291→			ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   292→			Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   293→			Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   294→		}{
   295→			Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   296→			ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   297→			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   298→			Data:      opts.IncrementalData,
   299→		}
   300→		cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(incrementalCheckpoint, "", "  ")
   301→		if err != nil {
   302→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   303→		}
   304→
   305→		cpBlobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, cpData)
   306→		if err != nil {
   307→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create incremental checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   308→		}
   309→		cpFilename := fmt.Sprintf("%03d-%s.json", opts.IncrementalSequence, opts.ToolUseID)
   310→		cpPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoints/" + cpFilename
   311→		entries[cpPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   312→			Name: cpPath,
   313→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   314→			Hash: cpBlobHash,
   315→		}
   316→	} else {
   317→		// Final checkpoint: add transcripts and checkpoint.json
   318→
   319→		// Add session transcript (with chunking support for large transcripts)
   320→		if opts.TranscriptPath != "" {
   321→			if transcriptContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.TranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   322→				// Detect agent type from content for proper chunking
   323→				agentType := ""
   324→				if isGeminiJSONFormat(transcriptContent) {
   325→					agentType = "Gemini"
   326→				}
   327→
   328→				// Chunk if necessary
   329→				chunks, chunkErr := ChunkTranscript(transcriptContent, agentType)
   330→				if chunkErr == nil {
   331→					for i, chunk := range chunks {
   332→						chunkPath := sessionMetadataDir + "/" + ChunkFileName(paths.TranscriptFileName, i)
   333→						if blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, chunk); blobErr == nil {
   334→							entries[chunkPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   335→								Name: chunkPath,
   336→								Mode: filemode.Regular,
   337→								Hash: blobHash,
   338→							}
   339→						}
   340→					}
   341→				}
   342→			}
   343→		}
   344→
   345→		// Add subagent transcript if available
   346→		if opts.SubagentTranscriptPath != "" && opts.AgentID != "" {
   347→			if agentContent, readErr := os.ReadFile(opts.SubagentTranscriptPath); readErr == nil {
   348→				if blobHash, blobErr := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, agentContent); blobErr == nil {
   349→					agentPath := taskMetadataDir + "/agent-" + opts.AgentID + ".jsonl"
   350→					entries[agentPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   351→						Name: agentPath,
   352→						Mode: filemode.Regular,
   353→						Hash: blobHash,
   354→					}
   355→				}
   356→			}
   357→		}
   358→
   359→		// Add checkpoint.json
   360→		checkpointJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{
   361→  "session_id": %q,
   362→  "tool_use_id": %q,
   363→  "checkpoint_uuid": %q,
   364→  "agent_id": %q
   365→}`, opts.SessionID, opts.ToolUseID, opts.CheckpointUUID, opts.AgentID)
   366→
   367→		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(s.repo, []byte(checkpointJSON))
   368→		if err != nil {
   369→			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to create checkpoint blob: %w", err)
   370→		}
   371→		checkpointPath := taskMetadataDir + "/checkpoint.json"
   372→		entries[checkpointPath] = object.TreeEntry{
   373→			Name: checkpointPath,
   374→			Mode: filemode.Regular,
   375→			Hash: blobHash,
   376→		}
   377→	}
   378→
   379→	// Build new tree from entries
   380→	return BuildTreeFromEntries(s.repo, entries)
   381→}

   383→// ListTemporaryCheckpoints lists all checkpoint commits on a shadow branch.
   384→// This returns individual commits (rewind points), not just branch info.
   385→// The sessionID filter, if provided, limits results to commits from that session.
   386→func (s *GitStore) ListTemporaryCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, baseCommit string, sessionID string, limit int) ([]TemporaryCheckpointInfo, error) {
   387→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   388→
   389→	shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit)
   390→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   391→
   392→	ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   393→	if err != nil {
   394→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // No shadow branch is expected case
   395→	}
   396→
   397→	iter, err := s.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: ref.Hash()})
   398→	if err != nil {
   399→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   400→	}
   401→
   402→	var results []TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   403→	count := 0
   404→
   405→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   406→		if count >= limit*5 { // Scan more to allow for session filtering
   407→			return errStop
   408→		}
   409→		count++
   410→
   411→		// Verify commit belongs to target session via Entire-Session trailer
   412→		commitSessionID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(c.Message)
   413→		if !hasTrailer {
   414→			return nil // Skip commits without session trailer
   415→		}
   416→		if sessionID != "" && commitSessionID != sessionID {
   417→			return nil // Skip commits from other sessions
   418→		}
   419→
   420→		// Get first line of message
   421→		message := c.Message
   422→		if idx := strings.Index(message, "\n"); idx > 0 {
   423→			message = message[:idx]
   424→		}
   425→
   426→		info := TemporaryCheckpointInfo{
   427→			CommitHash: c.Hash,
   428→			Message:    message,
   429→			SessionID:  commitSessionID,
   430→			Timestamp:  c.Author.When,
   431→		}
   432→
   433→		// Check for task checkpoint first
   434→		taskMetadataDir, foundTask := trailers.ParseTaskMetadata(c.Message)
   435→		if foundTask {
   436→			info.IsTaskCheckpoint = true
   437→			info.MetadataDir = taskMetadataDir
   438→			info.ToolUseID = extractToolUseIDFromPath(taskMetadataDir)
   439→		} else {
   440→			metadataDir, found := trailers.ParseMetadata(c.Message)
   441→			if found {
   442→				info.MetadataDir = metadataDir
   443→			}
   444→		}
   445→
   446→		results = append(results, info)
   447→
   448→		if len(results) >= limit {
   449→			return errStop
   450→		}
   451→		return nil
   452→	})
   453→
   454→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   455→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   456→	}
   457→
   458→	return results, nil
   459→}
   460→
   461→// extractToolUseIDFromPath extracts the ToolUseID from a task metadata directory path.
   462→// Task metadata dirs have format: .entire/metadata/<session>/tasks/<toolUseID>
   463→func extractToolUseIDFromPath(metadataDir string) string {
   464→	parts := strings.Split(metadataDir, "/")
   465→	if len(parts) >= 2 && parts[len(parts)-2] == "tasks" {
   466→		return parts[len(parts)-1]
   467→	}
   468→	return ""
   469→}
   470→
   471→// errStop is a sentinel error used to break out of git log iteration.
   472→var errStop = errors.New("stop iteration")
   473→
   474→// GetTranscriptFromCommit retrieves the transcript from a specific commit's tree.
   475→// This is used for shadow branch checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the commit tree
   476→// rather than on the entire/sessions branch.
   477→// commitHash is the commit to read from, metadataDir is the path within the tree.
   478→// Handles both chunked and non-chunked transcripts.
   479→func (s *GitStore) GetTranscriptFromCommit(commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) ([]byte, error) {
   480→	commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   481→	if err != nil {
   482→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   483→	}
   484→
   485→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   486→	if err != nil {
   487→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   488→	}
   489→
   490→	// Try to get the metadata subtree for chunk detection
   491→	subTree, subTreeErr := tree.Tree(metadataDir)
   492→	if subTreeErr == nil {
   493→		// Use the helper function that handles chunking
   494→		// Pass empty agent type - it will be auto-detected from content
   495→		transcript, err := readTranscriptFromTree(subTree, "")
   496→		if err == nil && transcript != nil {
   497→			return transcript, nil
   498→		}
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	// Fall back to direct file access (for backwards compatibility)
   502→	transcriptPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName
   503→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {
   504→		content, contentErr := file.Contents()
   505→		if contentErr == nil {
   506→			return []byte(content), nil
   507→		}
   508→	}
   509→
   510→	transcriptPath = metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy
   511→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {
   512→		content, contentErr := file.Contents()
   513→		if contentErr == nil {
   514→			return []byte(content), nil
   515→		}
   516→	}
   517→
   518→	return nil, ErrNoTranscript
   519→}
